sentences.en: In 2011, the body of a woman was discovered in a California vineyard.
sentences.zh: 2011年，一具女性遗体在加利福尼亚州的一个葡萄园中被发现。

sentences.en: She had been decapitated, and her body had been drained of blood.
sentences.zh: 她遭到了斩首，且遗体内的血液已被排干。

sentences.en: It appeared her killer had gone to extraordinary lengths to conceal her identity.
sentences.zh: 凶手似乎费尽心机，试图掩盖她的身份。

sentences.en: For more than a decade, she was known only as Jane Doe.
sentences.zh: 十多年来，她一直被称为“简·多伊”（无名氏）。

sentences.en: Then, detectives finally learned her name, Ada.
sentences.zh: 直到后来，侦探们终于查明了她的名字——艾达。

sentences.en: But, identifying her only made this bizarre murder even more perplexing.
sentences.zh: 然而，确认她的身份反而让这起离奇的谋杀案变得更加扑朔迷离。

sentences.en: Ada is the new series from Casefile Presents, available now wherever you get your podcasts.
sentences.zh: 《艾达》是“Casefile Presents”推出的全新系列节目，现已在各大播客平台上线。

sentences.en: This episode was originally released on Casefile's Patreon, Apple Premium and Spotify Premium feeds as an early bonus for our paid subscribers.
sentences.zh: 本集最初作为给付费订阅者的早期福利，发布在Casefile的Patreon、Apple Premium和Spotify Premium频道上。

sentences.en: These episodes are designed to be slightly shorter, allowing us to cover a broader range of cases.
sentences.zh: 这些剧集篇幅较短，旨在让我们能够涵盖更广泛的案件。

sentences.en: To receive these episodes early and ad-free, you can support Casefile on your preferred platform.
sentences.zh: 如需抢先收听且无广告的剧集，您可以在您偏好的平台上支持Casefile。

sentences.en: Please note that this episode discusses the subject of suicide and won't be suitable for all listeners.
sentences.zh: 请注意，本集涉及自杀话题，可能并不适合所有听众。

sentences.en: If you need support, please visit lifeline.org.au.
sentences.zh: 如果您需要帮助，请访问lifeline.org.au。

sentences.en: For listeners outside of Australia, you can find a list of mental health resources on the Crisis Links page of our website.
sentences.zh: 澳大利亚境外的听众，可以在我们网站的“危机链接”（Crisis Links）页面找到心理健康资源列表。

sentences.en: During the summer of 2006, English grandmother Celia Blay found herself spending more and more time on the internet.
sentences.zh: 2006年夏天，英国祖母西莉亚·布莱发现自己花在互联网上的时间越来越多。

sentences.en: At almost 60 years of age, Celia was a retired teacher and a self-professed technophobe with minimal computer experience.
sentences.zh: 西莉亚当时快60岁了，是一名退休教师，自称是“技术恐惧者”，几乎没什么电脑使用经验。

sentences.en: But after both of her elderly parents died in quick succession, Celia found that being online was a good distraction from her grief.
sentences.zh: 但在她年迈的双亲相继去世后，西莉亚发现上网是排解悲伤的好方法。

sentences.en: Although Celia kept horses and had a small business making whips for carriages, these hobbies weren't enough to fill up her days.
sentences.zh: 尽管西莉亚养马，还经营着一家制作马车鞭子的小生意，但这些爱好不足以填满她的生活。

sentences.en: Celia liked to browse newsgroups within the Usenet system.
sentences.zh: 西莉亚喜欢浏览Usenet系统里的新闻组。

sentences.en: Newsgroups operated the same way as message forums, with separate groups dedicated to all kinds of subjects such as pop culture, music, travel, and many others.
sentences.zh: 新闻组的运作方式与留言论坛相同，设有专门针对流行文化、音乐、旅游等各种主题的独立版块。

sentences.en: Celia mostly stuck to the history newsgroup and she had a particular interest in medieval history.
sentences.zh: 西莉亚大多只关注历史新闻组，她对中世纪历史尤为感兴趣。

sentences.en: As well as being an informative hobby, using the forums was a way to meet and chat with like-minded people.
sentences.zh: 使用这些论坛不仅是一种增长见识的爱好，也是结识志同道合之人并进行交流的途径。

sentences.en: If a user was a member of multiple newsgroups, this information could be found on their profile.
sentences.zh: 如果用户是多个新闻组的成员，这些信息可以在他们的个人资料中看到。

sentences.en: One day, Celia was looking at the profile of another regular poster when she noticed they belonged to a second group called alt.suicide.holiday, also known as Ash.
sentences.zh: 一天，西莉亚在查看另一位常客的个人资料时，注意到他们属于第二个名为“alt.suicide.holiday”（简称ASH）的群组。

sentences.en: The strange name caught Celia's attention.
sentences.zh: 这个奇怪的名字引起了西莉亚的注意。

sentences.en: She had no idea there were forums for people who wanted to discuss killing themselves, and she was shocked.
sentences.zh: 她根本不知道还有专门供想自杀的人讨论的论坛，这让她感到震惊。

sentences.en: Out of pure curiosity, Celia hovered her mouse over the link, then clicked on it.
sentences.zh: 出于纯粹的好奇，西莉亚将鼠标悬停在链接上，然后点击了进去。

sentences.en: Celia Blay had never contemplated suicide herself, but she knew how it felt to be depressed.
sentences.zh: 西莉亚·布莱本人从未考虑过自杀，但她了解抑郁的感受。

sentences.en: The recent deaths of her parents had plunged Celia into an intense grieving period, leaving her battling some very painful feelings and low moods.
sentences.zh: 父母的离世让西莉亚陷入了深重的悲痛期，她不得不与那些痛苦的情绪和低落的心境作斗争。

sentences.en: As Celia began to explore the Ash Forum, she saw that many of the users were experiencing extreme sadness and suicidal thoughts.
sentences.zh: 当西莉亚开始探索ASH论坛时，她发现许多用户都在经历极度的悲伤和自杀念头。

sentences.en: Some individuals weren't suicidal themselves, but offered psychological support to those who were.
sentences.zh: 有些人自己并没有自杀倾向，但会为那些有自杀倾向的人提供心理支持。

sentences.en: Others were trolls, who seemed to enjoy mocking and goading the suicidal forum users.
sentences.zh: 还有一些人是“喷子”，他们似乎以嘲笑和怂恿论坛里的自杀者为乐。

sentences.en: In addition to talking about their desire to end their lives, posters debated the larger philosophical issues around life and death.
sentences.zh: 除了讨论结束生命的渴望，发帖者还会探讨关于生与死的宏大哲学议题。

sentences.en: Celia was a compassionate person, and her heart went out to these people who were suffering.
sentences.zh: 西莉亚是一个富有同情心的人，她对这些受苦的人深感同情。

sentences.en: Identifying with some of the feelings users were describing, she also found some comfort in knowing she wasn't alone.
sentences.zh: 由于对用户描述的一些感受产生了共鸣，她也从“自己并不孤单”的认知中获得了一些安慰。

sentences.en: While some of the conversations were too dark for Celia's liking, she was engaged by the deep discussions and thoughtful responses.
sentences.zh: 虽然有些对话对西莉亚来说过于阴暗，但她被那些深刻的讨论和深思熟虑的回复所吸引。

sentences.en: Celia began to post on the board too, and quickly made connections with other regulars.
sentences.zh: 西莉亚也开始在论坛上发帖，并很快与其他常客建立了联系。

sentences.en: Some of the individuals were teenagers who had their whole lives ahead of them, yet couldn't see the possibility of a bright future.
sentences.zh: 其中一些人是青少年，他们的人生才刚刚开始，却看不到光明未来的可能。

sentences.en: As a former teacher, Celia particularly felt for these young people.
sentences.zh: 作为一名前教师，西莉亚对这些年轻人尤为关切。

sentences.en: She reached out to them and encouraged them to think positively, assuring them that life would get better.
sentences.zh: 她主动联系他们，鼓励他们积极思考，向他们保证生活会好起来的。

sentences.en: One of the posters Celia began to correspond with regularly was a 17-year-old girl from Central America called Anna, not her real name.
sentences.zh: 西莉亚开始定期通信的一位发帖者，是来自中美洲的一名17岁女孩，化名安娜。

sentences.en: Anna was a survivor of sexual abuse, had very low self-esteem, and was deeply depressed.
sentences.zh: 安娜是性虐待的幸存者，自尊心极低，且患有严重的抑郁症。

sentences.en: She felt that suicide was the only way out.
sentences.zh: 她觉得自杀是唯一的出路。

sentences.en: Celia messaged Anna often, trying to boost her confidence, and telling her that depression was a treatable illness for which suicide was not the answer.
sentences.zh: 西莉亚经常给安娜发消息，试图增强她的自信，并告诉她抑郁症是一种可治疗的疾病，自杀并非答案。

sentences.en: Celia assured Anna that there were people who could help, and encouraged her to speak to her doctor, friends, or prieSt.
sentences.zh: 西莉亚向安娜保证有人可以提供帮助，并鼓励她向医生、朋友或牧师倾诉。

sentences.en: Over the course of several weeks, Celia started to feel like she was making progress with Anna.
sentences.zh: 在接下来的几周里，西莉亚开始觉得她在安娜身上取得了进展。

sentences.en: The teenager seemed to be turning a corner.
sentences.zh: 这个少女似乎正在走出阴霾。

sentences.en: Then one day, Celia received an email from Anna that changed everything.
sentences.zh: 然而有一天，西莉亚收到了一封来自安娜的邮件，一切都改变了。

sentences.en: I am going to kill myself at 4 o'clock on Friday, it read.
sentences.zh: “我将在周五下午4点自杀，”邮件写道。

sentences.en: I have made a pact with another girl.
sentences.zh: “我已经和另一个女孩约定好了。”

sentences.en: Anna explained to Celia that she had been talking with another member of ASH.
sentences.zh: 安娜向西莉亚解释说，她一直在和ASH的另一位成员交谈。

sentences.en: Her name was Li Dao, and she was a 20-something Chinese-American woman who lived in the state of Minnesota.
sentences.zh: 她的名字叫李道（Li Dao），是一位20多岁的华裔美国女性，住在明尼苏达州。

sentences.en: Li Dao worked as a nurse in a hospital emergency room and had seen patients rushed in after botched suicide attempts.
sentences.zh: 李道在一家医院的急诊室当护士，曾见过病人因自杀未遂被紧急送来。

sentences.en: She told Anna that it was very difficult to kill yourself.
sentences.zh: 她告诉安娜，自杀其实非常困难。

sentences.en: Many people survived their attempts and had to then live with terrible injuries that sometimes left them incapacitated.
sentences.zh: 许多人尝试后幸存下来，却不得不带着可怕的伤残生活，有时甚至导致丧失自理能力。

sentences.en: Through her nursing work, Li Dao had concluded that the only surefire way to die by suicide was to hang yourself.
sentences.zh: 通过护士工作，李道断定唯一万无一失的自杀方式就是上吊。

sentences.en: She provided Anna with explicit, step-by-step instructions on doing so, even telling her what kind of supplies she would need to purchase beforehand.
sentences.zh: 她为安娜提供了明确的、分步骤的操作指南，甚至告诉她事先需要购买哪些用品。

sentences.en: Like Anna, Li Dao was deeply depressed and suicidal.
sentences.zh: 和安娜一样，李道也深陷抑郁并有自杀倾向。

sentences.en: She suggested that she and Anna end their lives together at the same time.
sentences.zh: 她建议她和安娜在同一时间一起结束生命。

sentences.en: Having someone to go through it would reduce the fear and Li Dao could make sure Anna was following her directions properly.
sentences.zh: 有个人一起经历会减少恐惧，而且李道可以确保安娜正确地按照她的指示去做。

sentences.en: Although Celia was horrified by Anna's revelation, she thought Li Dao's suggestion sounded absurd, given that she and Anna lived in different countries.
sentences.zh: 尽管西莉亚对安娜的披露感到惊恐，但考虑到她和安娜身处不同国家，她觉得李道的建议听起来很荒谬。

sentences.en: Celia replied to Anna immediately, saying,
sentences.zh: 西莉亚立即回复安娜说：

sentences.en: Surely this nurse is not going to travel to Central America to hang herself alongside you.
sentences.zh: “这个护士肯定不会为了和你一起上吊而跑到中美洲去。”

sentences.en: Anna explained that they wouldn't be together in person.
sentences.zh: 安娜解释说，她们不会亲自见面。

sentences.en: Li Dao had suggested they go online at the same time and turn on their webcaMs.
sentences.zh: 李道建议她们同时上线并打开摄像头。

sentences.en: That way they could watch each other from their respective homes as they hanged themselves at the same time.
sentences.zh: 这样她们就可以在各自的家中，看着对方同时上吊。

sentences.en: Celia noticed that Anna sounded somewhat reluctant.
sentences.zh: 西莉亚注意到安娜听起来有些犹豫。

sentences.en: It seemed that she wasn't certain about wanting to end her life, but she repeatedly said that she didn't want to let down Li Dao.
sentences.zh: 似乎她并不确定自己真的想结束生命，但她反复说不想让李道失望。

sentences.en: Celia set about trying to convince Anna to break her pact.
sentences.zh: 西莉亚开始试图说服安娜打破约定。

sentences.en: Anna's life was far more important than a promise to a stranger online.
sentences.zh: 安娜的生命远比对一个网络陌生人的承诺重要。

sentences.en: To Celia's relief, she persuaded Anna not to harm herself.
sentences.zh: 令西莉亚欣慰的是，她成功说服了安娜不要伤害自己。

sentences.en: But that wasn't enough for Celia.
sentences.zh: 但这对西莉亚来说还不够。

sentences.en: Celia was furious that there was an adult out there who would convince a vulnerable teenager to take her own life and assist them in doing so, instead of offering help or support.
sentences.zh: 西莉亚非常愤怒，竟然有一个成年人会去说服一个脆弱的青少年自杀，并协助她实施，而不是提供帮助或支持。

sentences.en: Celia began to wonder exactly what sort of person Li Dao was.
sentences.zh: 西莉亚开始好奇李道究竟是什么样的人。

sentences.en: There weren't many posts from Li Dao in the suicide group's main forum.
sentences.zh: 在自杀群组的主论坛里，李道的帖子并不多。

sentences.en: Those she did leave indicated that she had a caring and compassionate personality.
sentences.zh: 她留下的那些帖子表明她有着关怀和富有同情心的性格。

sentences.en: She was kind and affectionate with other board members, often referring to people she addressed as hun and signing off messages with the word hugs.
sentences.zh: 她对其他成员很友善、亲切，经常称呼对方为“亲爱的”（hun），并在消息末尾写上“拥抱”作为签名。

sentences.en: However, on one occasion, Li Dao had gotten upset with someone who suggested that people who were suicidal should seek refuge in substance abuse instead of death.
sentences.zh: 然而，有一次，李道对某人表示不满，因为那个人建议有自杀倾向的人应该通过滥用药物来逃避，而不是选择死亡。

sentences.en: Another comment from Li Dao indicated that she was a practising Christian.
sentences.zh: 李道的另一条评论表明她是一名虔诚的基督徒。

sentences.en: This perspective was somewhat rare within the group's community, with many users stating they were disillusioned with organised religion.
sentences.zh: 这种观点在群组社区中相当罕见，许多用户都表示对有组织的宗教感到幻灭。

sentences.en: It also seemed odd that a professed Christian would be in favour of suicide when the religion expressly forbids it.
sentences.zh: 一个自称基督徒的人竟然支持自杀，而宗教明确禁止自杀，这看起来也很奇怪。

sentences.en: Outside of these occasional public posts, it seemed that Li Dao primarily communicated with other users via direct message.
sentences.zh: 除了这些偶尔的公开帖子外，李道似乎主要是通过私信与其他用户交流。

sentences.en: In March of 2006, a user going by the handle Half Jacket had posted,
sentences.zh: 2006年3月，一位网名为“Half Jacket”的用户发帖称：

sentences.en: Please someone help me die some way that is quick and or painless directly.
sentences.zh: “请谁能直接帮我找一种快速且无痛的死亡方式。”

sentences.en: I'll do anything.
sentences.zh: “我什么都愿意做。”

sentences.en: Please.
sentences.zh: “求求你们。”

sentences.en: I just need help.
sentences.zh: “我只需要帮助。”

sentences.en: Li Dao had replied to this message, simply writing,
sentences.zh: 李道回复了这条消息，只写了一句：

sentences.en: Check your email.
sentences.zh: “查收你的邮件。”

sentences.en: Several months later, in July, a user calling himself Jim said he planned to hang himself and was seeking advice on how to do so correctly.
sentences.zh: 几个月后的7月，一位自称吉姆的用户说他计划上吊自杀，并寻求如何正确实施的建议。

sentences.en: Li Dao once again responded with the words,
sentences.zh: 李道再次回复道：

sentences.en: Check your email.
sentences.zh: “查收你的邮件。”

sentences.en: Celia Blay had a suspicion that something untoward was going on.
sentences.zh: 西莉亚·布莱怀疑有什么不妥的事情正在发生。

sentences.en: Due to her lack of experience with the internet, she asked her son Paul to help her dig deeper into Li Dao's forum posts.
sentences.zh: 由于缺乏互联网经验，她请儿子保罗帮忙深入挖掘李道的论坛帖子。

sentences.en: With Paul's assistance, Celia tracked down more and more messages that Li Dao had left in the forum.
sentences.zh: 在保罗的协助下，西莉亚追踪到了李道在论坛上留下的更多消息。

sentences.en: It looked like she had struck up private conversations with dozens of other users.
sentences.zh: 看起来她已经与数十名其他用户建立了私人联系。

sentences.en: But what troubled Celia most was that sometimes after a user befriended Li Dao, they then disappeared entirely.
sentences.zh: 但最让西莉亚不安的是，有时在用户与李道成为朋友后，他们就彻底消失了。

sentences.en: In early 2006, a 22-year-old researcher from Croatia named Nikola took to Ash to share some thoughts he'd had about taking his own life.
sentences.zh: 2006年初，一名来自克罗地亚的22岁研究员尼古拉在ASH论坛上分享了他关于自杀的想法。

sentences.en: Within two hours of sharing the post, Nikola had a reply from Li Dao telling him to check his email.
sentences.zh: 发帖后不到两小时，尼古拉就收到了李道的回复，让她查收邮件。

sentences.en: In a private message, Li Dao told Nikola that she knew exactly how he felt.
sentences.zh: 在私信中，李道告诉尼古拉，她完全理解他的感受。

sentences.en: For more than a decade, she'd been struggling with depression and bipolar disorder.
sentences.zh: 十多年来，她一直饱受抑郁症和双相情感障碍的折磨。

sentences.en: Despite going to therapy, taking medication, and seeking strength from her religious faith, her circumstances never seemed to improve.
sentences.zh: 尽管接受了治疗、服用了药物，并从宗教信仰中寻求力量，但她的状况似乎从未好转。

sentences.en: Li Dao told Nikola,
sentences.zh: 李道告诉尼古拉：

sentences.en: I'm really tired of living a false life and pretending everything is okay when it is not and I can't do it anymore.
sentences.zh: “我真的厌倦了过虚假的生活，假装一切都好，其实不然，我再也坚持不下去了。”

sentences.en: The two began conversing more frequently and over the course of six months, they grew close.
sentences.zh: 两人开始更频繁地交流，在六个月的时间里，他们变得亲密起来。

sentences.en: Nikola found comfort in knowing there was someone else who could relate to how he felt.
sentences.zh: 尼古拉发现有人能理解他的感受，这让他感到安慰。

sentences.en: Li Dao assured him that he wasn't alone.
sentences.zh: 李道向他保证，他并不孤单。

sentences.en: But she didn't have plans to stick around.
sentences.zh: 但她并没有打算继续活下去。

sentences.en: Li Dao confided in Nikola that she was planning to take her own life by hanging.
sentences.zh: 李道向尼古拉吐露，她计划通过上吊结束自己的生命。

sentences.en: She told him that she'd been practising it in private.
sentences.zh: 她告诉他，她一直在私下练习。

sentences.en: If Nikola was serious about wanting to die, Li Dao encouraged him to hang himself too.
sentences.zh: 如果尼古拉真的想死，李道鼓励他也上吊自杀。

sentences.en: She claimed it was the quickest and easiest method.
sentences.zh: 她声称这是最快、最简单的方法。

sentences.en: Li Dao provided instructions and suggested they enter into a suicide pact together.
sentences.zh: 李道提供了指导，并建议他们一起签订自杀协议。

sentences.en: Nikola agreed.
sentences.zh: 尼古拉同意了。

sentences.en: A date was set but Nikola found he couldn't go through with it.
sentences.zh: 日期定下了，但尼古拉发现自己无法付诸行动。

sentences.en: As well as being scared of the pain, he feared what awaited him after death.
sentences.zh: 除了害怕痛苦，他还担心死后会面临什么。

sentences.en: He admitted to Li Dao that he was worried there might be nothing afterwards and the thought of that terrified him.
sentences.zh: 他向李道承认，他担心死后可能什么都没有，这个想法让他感到恐惧。

sentences.en: Li Dao reassured Nikola that God was real and so was heaven and encouraged him to convert to Christianity.
sentences.zh: 李道向尼古拉保证上帝是真实存在的，天堂也是，并鼓励他皈依基督教。

sentences.en: Nikola and Li Dao set more dates for their suicide pact, but each time Nikola found himself unable to participate.
sentences.zh: 尼古拉和李道又定下了几个自杀协议的日期，但每次尼古拉都发现自己无法参与。

sentences.en: Then in September 2006, other posters began wondering where Li Dao was after she suddenly stopped posting in the public forum.
sentences.zh: 2006年9月，其他发帖者开始纳闷李道去了哪里，因为她突然停止在公共论坛发帖了。

sentences.en: One person begged her to reach out if she was alive and well, while another deduced that she must have finally taken her life.
sentences.zh: 有人恳求她如果还活着就回个话，另一个人则推断她肯定已经自杀了。

sentences.en: Nikola reassured them that Li Dao was fine.
sentences.zh: 尼古拉向他们保证李道没事。

sentences.en: He had heard from her just two days earlier.
sentences.zh: 他两天前刚收到她的消息。

sentences.en: He added that she was still alive because, quote,
sentences.zh: 他补充说她还活着，因为，引用原话：

sentences.en: We kind of promised to each other to do it the same day.
sentences.zh: “我们约定好在同一天做这件事。”

sentences.en: She is ready to die.
sentences.zh: “她准备好去死了。”

sentences.en: She is just waiting for me to be ready.
sentences.zh: “她只是在等我准备好。”

sentences.en: Another user soon replied, writing,
sentences.zh: 另一位用户很快回复道：

sentences.en: She told you that too.
sentences.zh: “她也跟你这么说。”

sentences.en: Oi.
It seemed that Li Dao had entered into suicide pacts with multiple people.
sentences.zh: 看来李道已经与多人签订了自杀协议。

sentences.en: These pacts were scheduled for different days and different times.
sentences.zh: 这些协议被安排在不同的日子和不同的时间。

sentences.en: It was unclear why she had done this.
sentences.zh: 目前尚不清楚她为什么要这样做。

sentences.en: The following day, Nikola received an email from a woman claiming to be Li Dao's mother.
sentences.zh: 第二天，尼古拉收到了一封自称是李道母亲的女性发来的邮件。

sentences.en: Using her daughter's account, she told Nikola that she had found Li's body hanging in their basement at 6.40 that morning.
sentences.zh: 她用女儿的账号告诉尼古拉，她在当天早上6点40分发现李的遗体悬挂在地下室里。

sentences.en: Although the family was devastated by her loss, they found comfort in knowing her pain was finally over.
sentences.zh: 尽管家人对她的离世感到悲痛欲绝，但想到她的痛苦终于结束了，他们感到了一丝安慰。

sentences.en: Nikola was bereft that Li Dao was gone and grew even more determined to take his own life.
sentences.zh: 尼古拉为李道的离去感到悲痛，并更加坚定了自杀的决心。

sentences.en: Two months later, he logged onto the Ash Forum and read something shocking.
sentences.zh: 两个月后，他登录ASH论坛，读到了一些令人震惊的内容。

sentences.en: One of the other posters had received a message from Li Dao.
sentences.zh: 其他发帖者中的一人收到了李道的消息。

sentences.en: She was still alive.
sentences.zh: 她还活着。

sentences.en: Nikola realised he'd been lied to.
sentences.zh: 尼古拉意识到自己被骗了。

sentences.en: He posted in the forum, quote,
sentences.zh: 他在论坛上发帖，引用原话：

sentences.en: It's not Li.
sentences.zh: “那不是李。”

sentences.en: She doesn't exiSt.
sentences.zh: “她根本不存在。”

sentences.en: It's some perv fucking with us.
sentences.zh: “是个变态在耍我们。”

sentences.en: Other users agreed.
sentences.zh: 其他用户表示同意。

sentences.en: Upon comparing notes, they discovered that Li Dao had always recommended people kill themselves by hanging and always suggested they take their lives together via webcam.
sentences.zh: 在交换信息后，他们发现李道总是建议人们通过上吊自杀，并总是建议他们通过摄像头一起自杀。

sentences.en: One individual who had regularly exchanged private messages with Li Dao said she was always trying to convince him to hang himself.
sentences.zh: 一位经常与李道私下交流的人说，她总是试图说服他上吊自杀。

sentences.en: He'd wanted to talk with her over the phone, but she always had some excuse why that wasn't possible.
sentences.zh: 他曾想和她通电话，但她总是有各种借口推脱。

sentences.en: This poster told the other forum members.
sentences.zh: 这位发帖者告诉其他论坛成员：

sentences.en: I believe Li Dao got some kind of high or rush from trying to convince people to die.
sentences.zh: “我相信李道从试图说服人们去死中获得了一种快感或刺激。”

sentences.en: Celia Blay agreed.
sentences.zh: 西莉亚·布莱同意了。

sentences.en: Her private investigation into Li Dao's messages coincided with the other forum members realising what was really going on.
sentences.zh: 她对李道（Li Dao）留言的私人调查，恰逢论坛其他成员意识到真相之时。

sentences.en: Word spread on Ash that Celia was looking into Li Dao, and soon she received a tip-off that Li was now using another handle,
sentences.zh: 关于西莉亚正在调查李道的消息在Ash论坛上传开，很快她就收到线报，称李道现在换了另一个账号，

sentences.en: Falcongirl, Falcongirl.
sentences.zh: 叫“猎鹰女孩”（Falcongirl），猎鹰女孩。

sentences.en: Celia conducted a search for messages posted under that username and immediately noted that Falcongirl's style bore a striking similarity to Li Dao's.
sentences.zh: 西莉亚搜索了该用户名发布的帖子，立刻发现“猎鹰女孩”的风格与李道惊人地相似。

sentences.en: When users posted publicly about their desire to end their life, Falcongirl replied with the familiar instruction,
sentences.zh: 每当有用户公开表达轻生念头时，“猎鹰女孩”就会回复那句熟悉的指令：

sentences.en: Check your email.
sentences.zh: 查看你的电子邮件。

sentences.en: Celia was determined to put a stop to this.
sentences.zh: 西莉亚决心阻止这一切。

sentences.en: She began reaching out to forum members who had been contacted by Li Dao.
sentences.zh: 她开始联系那些曾被李道接触过的论坛成员。

sentences.en: Celia was disturbed by how young some of the members were.
sentences.zh: 西莉亚对其中一些成员的年纪之小感到不安。

sentences.en: One was a schoolboy, while another was a 12-year-old girl.
sentences.zh: 其中一个是男学生，另一个是12岁的小女孩。

sentences.en: Celia asked Li's friends if they would let her access their chat logs with the nurse.
sentences.zh: 西莉亚询问李道的朋友，是否愿意让她查看他们与这位护士的聊天记录。

sentences.en: She wanted to alert the authorities as to what was going on, and promised to keep the identities of all the forum members private.
sentences.zh: 她想向当局举报此事，并承诺对所有论坛成员的身份保密。

sentences.en: Thirty people agreed to Celia's terms and sent her records of their conversations with Li Dao.
sentences.zh: 三十人同意了西莉亚的条件，并将他们与李道的对话记录发给了她。

sentences.en: After collating this information, Celia left her quiet Berkshire village and headed for the nearest police station in Maidenhead.
sentences.zh: 整理完这些信息后，西莉亚离开了她安静的伯克郡村庄，前往最近的梅登黑德警察局。

sentences.en: A quaint and leafy market town that sits on the River Thames, Maidenhead had a low crime rate and was ranked as one of England's safest places.
sentences.zh: 梅登黑德是一座坐落在泰晤士河畔、古朴而绿树成荫的集镇，犯罪率很低，被评为英国最安全的地方之一。

sentences.en: When Celia entered the police station with her brief of evidence, she asked to see the officer in charge of online crimes.
sentences.zh: 当西莉亚带着证据摘要走进警察局时，她要求见负责网络犯罪的警官。

sentences.en: She ran him through the information she'd gathered, stating,
sentences.zh: 她向他详细介绍了自己收集的信息，并说道：

sentences.en: Look, this person is trying to get people to kill themselves.
sentences.zh: “听着，这个人正在诱导人们自杀。”

sentences.en: But the officer didn't seem interested.
sentences.zh: 但那位警官似乎并不感兴趣。

sentences.en: He dismissed Li Dao's messages as those of an online troll who was simply trying to wind people up.
sentences.zh: 他将李道的留言斥为网络喷子的恶作剧，认为对方只是想激怒他人。

sentences.en: Celia could tell her concerns weren't going to be taken seriously.
sentences.zh: 西莉亚看得出来，她的担忧不会被认真对待。

sentences.en: As she made her way out of the station, an officer remarked,
sentences.zh: 当她走出警局时，一名警官评论道：

sentences.en: More than a year later, on the morning of Monday, March 10, 2008,
sentences.zh: 一年多后的2008年3月10日，星期一早晨，

sentences.en: students at Carleton University in the Canadian capital of Ottawa complained about loud music that had been blasting from a dorm room all night long.
sentences.zh: 加拿大首都渥太华卡尔顿大学的学生们抱怨说，一间宿舍整晚都在播放震耳欲聋的音乐。

sentences.en: The dorm room in question belonged to 18-year-old Naja Kijuji, a first-year student majoring in public affairs and policy.
sentences.zh: 那间宿舍的主人是18岁的娜嘉·基朱吉（Naja Kijuji），一名主修公共事务与政策的大一新生。

sentences.en: Naja was known as a happy, outgoing and confident person with an independence streak and a passion for politics.
sentences.zh: 娜嘉以开朗、外向、自信著称，性格独立，且对政治充满热情。

sentences.en: When campus security arrived at Naja's dorm room, they found it was empty.
sentences.zh: 当校园保安到达娜嘉的宿舍时，发现里面空无一人。

sentences.en: Naja was gone, and so was her winter coat and cell phone.
sentences.zh: 娜嘉不见了，她的冬大衣和手机也不见了。

sentences.en: However, her iPod was still there, paused in the middle of playing a song, and so was her wallet.
sentences.zh: 然而，她的iPod还在，正暂停在一首歌的播放界面，钱包也还在。

sentences.en: It contained her driver's license, credit cards, and more than $200 cash.
sentences.zh: 钱包里有她的驾照、信用卡和200多美元现金。

sentences.en: There were no clues as to where Naja might be, but the fact that she'd left her wallet behind seemed to indicate she hadn't planned on staying away for long.
sentences.zh: 没有任何线索表明娜嘉去了哪里，但她留下了钱包，似乎表明她没打算离开太久。

sentences.en: Meanwhile, more than 300 miles away in Toronto, Naja's parents were desperately trying to reach her.
sentences.zh: 与此同时，在300多英里外的多伦多，娜嘉的父母正焦急地试图联系她。

sentences.en: They called Naja repeatedly, but she didn't answer her phone.
sentences.zh: 他们多次拨打娜嘉的电话，但她一直没接。

sentences.en: Two days later, on Wednesday March 12, they received a call from Carlton University's security department.
sentences.zh: 两天后，即3月12日星期三，他们接到了卡尔顿大学保安部门的电话。

sentences.en: They were checking to see whether Naja had gone home for a visit, as she hadn't been seen by anyone on campus for three days.
sentences.zh: 他们是在核实娜嘉是否回家探亲了，因为已经有三天没人见过她了。

sentences.en: Naja's parents were stunned that it had taken so long for the university to reach out to them.
sentences.zh: 娜嘉的父母对学校过了这么久才联系他们感到震惊。

sentences.en: They hadn't seen Naja since the previous month and insisted that security and Ottawa police start looking for their daughter, certain that she'd fallen victim to foul play.
sentences.zh: 他们上个月就没见过娜嘉了，并坚持要求保安和渥太华警方开始寻找他们的女儿，确信她已经遭遇了不测。

sentences.en: Naja's father, Muhammad, and brother, Mark, made the long journey to Ottawa so they could search for Naja themselves.
sentences.zh: 娜嘉的父亲穆罕默德（Muhammad）和哥哥马克（Mark）长途跋涉来到渥太华，以便亲自寻找娜嘉。

sentences.en: They also offered a $50,000 reward for her safe return.
sentences.zh: 他们还悬赏5万美元，希望能换回女儿平安归来。

sentences.en: Meanwhile, police began their own investigation.
sentences.zh: 与此同时，警方也开始了他们的调查。

sentences.en: The only clue they had to Naja's whereabouts lay in an email she'd sent to a friend on the evening of Sunday March 9.
sentences.zh: 他们掌握的关于娜嘉下落的唯一线索，是她3月9日星期日晚上发给朋友的一封邮件。

sentences.en: In it, she mentioned that she was about to head out to go ice skating.
sentences.zh: 在邮件中，她提到自己正准备出门去滑冰。

sentences.en: Although it was almost spring, Ottawa was experiencing one of the harshest winters ever recorded.
sentences.zh: 尽管已近春天，但渥太华正经历着有记录以来最严酷的冬天之一。

sentences.en: The city was still blanketed with fresh snowfall and the nearby Rideau River was frozen over.
sentences.zh: 城市仍被新雪覆盖，附近的里多河（Rideau River）也已结冰。

sentences.en: Ice skating was a popular pastime for Carlton University students and also a means of transportation.
sentences.zh: 滑冰是卡尔顿大学学生的一种流行消遣，也是一种交通方式。

sentences.en: Investigators searched Naja's dorm room and, sure enough, her ice skates were one of the few items missing.
sentences.zh: 调查人员搜查了娜嘉的宿舍，果然，她的冰鞋是少数几件不见了的物品之一。

sentences.en: Stuck to one wall was a note Naja had written to herself which read,
sentences.zh: 墙上贴着一张娜嘉写给自己的便条，上面写着：

sentences.en: They seized a number of Naja's personal belongings, including her computer.
sentences.zh: 他们查封了娜嘉的一些个人物品，包括她的电脑。

sentences.en: As investigators scoured the computer for clues, they came across a number of videos Naja had made.
sentences.zh: 当调查人员在电脑中搜寻线索时，他们发现了娜嘉拍摄的一些视频。

sentences.en: In them, Naja sat in her dorm room in front of her webcam and spoke about her life.
sentences.zh: 视频里，娜嘉坐在宿舍的摄像头前，讲述着自己的生活。

sentences.en: She hadn't published these videos anywhere online, instead opting to keep them as a private way of processing and talking through her feelings.
sentences.zh: 她没有把这些视频发布到网上，而是选择将它们作为一种私人的方式，来处理和倾诉自己的感受。

sentences.en: Early videos seemed upbeat, with Naja modelling different outfits that she liked.
sentences.zh: 早期的视频看起来很乐观，娜嘉在视频里展示着她喜欢的不同服装。

sentences.en: When Naja started college, she had broken up with her high school boyfriend and soon met someone new.
sentences.zh: 娜嘉上大学时，刚与高中男友分手，不久就遇到了新欢。

sentences.en: She fell head over heels for her new boyfriend, but her feelings weren't reciprocated.
sentences.zh: 她对新男友坠入爱河，但对方并没有给予同样的回应。

sentences.en: He had ended the relationship, leaving Naja devastated.
sentences.zh: 他结束了这段关系，让娜嘉深受打击。

sentences.en: Her suffering intensified when she discovered she was pregnant.
sentences.zh: 当她发现自己怀孕时，痛苦加剧了。

sentences.en: Naja wasn't ready to become a mother and didn't know what to do.
sentences.zh: 娜嘉还没准备好当母亲，不知道该怎么办。

sentences.en: Then, she suddenly miscarried.
sentences.zh: 随后，她突然流产了。

sentences.en: The experience left Naja feeling as though she had no control over her own body or destiny.
sentences.zh: 这段经历让娜嘉觉得，自己对身体和命运毫无掌控力。

sentences.en: As she described in one video diary entry, quote,
sentences.zh: 正如她在其中一篇视频日记中所述，引用如下：

sentences.en: I didn't want to get pregnant.
sentences.zh: “我不想怀孕。”

sentences.en: I didn't choose to get pregnant.
sentences.zh: “我不是自愿怀孕的。”

sentences.en: The condom broke.
sentences.zh: “避孕套破了。”

sentences.en: I took the morning after pill and it failed.
sentences.zh: “我吃了紧急避孕药，但失败了。”

sentences.en: So, I was pregnant and had no choice in the matter.
sentences.zh: “所以我怀孕了，对此我别无选择。”

sentences.en: And then I miscarried.
sentences.zh: “然后我流产了。”

sentences.en: So, I couldn't choose whether to keep the child or not keep the child.
sentences.zh: “所以我没法选择是留下孩子还是不留下孩子。”

sentences.en: Go through with the pregnancy.
sentences.zh: “是继续怀孕。”

sentences.en: Not go through with it.
sentences.zh: “还是不继续。”

sentences.en: Naja was heartbroken and deeply depressed.
sentences.zh: 娜嘉心碎不已，陷入了深深的抑郁。

sentences.en: Her support network of family and friends lived hundreds of miles away.
sentences.zh: 她的家人和朋友支持网络远在数百英里之外。

sentences.en: When she visited over Christmas, her family noticed her low mood.
sentences.zh: 圣诞节回家时，她的家人注意到了她情绪低落。

sentences.en: When she returned to college, Naja found it impossible to focus on her studies or sleep at night.
sentences.zh: 回到学校后，娜嘉发现自己无法专注于学业，晚上也睡不着觉。

sentences.en: Naja made appointments to see a psychiatrist and was prescribed antidepressants.
sentences.zh: 娜嘉预约了精神科医生，并被开了抗抑郁药。

sentences.en: She began self-medicating with alcohol and spent more and more time holed up in her dorm room.
sentences.zh: 她开始用酒精自我麻痹，花越来越多的时间躲在宿舍里。

sentences.en: Friends said she would lock the door and refuse to answer it when they knocked.
sentences.zh: 朋友们说，她会锁上门，敲门也不回应。

sentences.en: When she did occasionally emerge, the expression in her eyes was vacant, as though she wasn't quite present.
sentences.zh: 偶尔出来时，她的眼神空洞，仿佛灵魂出窍。

sentences.en: Naja's school grades plunged and it looked as though she would fail her second semester.
sentences.zh: 娜嘉的成绩一落千丈，看起来第二学期要挂科了。

sentences.en: Day-to-day functioning felt impossible for the 18-year-old.
sentences.zh: 对于这位18岁的女孩来说，维持日常运作都变得不可能。

sentences.en: She took to wearing an eye mask in her video diaries, hiding her face while she spoke about her pain.
sentences.zh: 她在视频日记中开始戴上眼罩，在讲述痛苦时遮住自己的脸。

sentences.en: In one recording, Naja detailed just how much she was struggling, stating,
sentences.zh: 在一段录音中，娜嘉详细描述了她挣扎的程度，说道：

sentences.en: I am depressed.
sentences.zh: “我抑郁了。”

sentences.en: I have postpartum mood disorder, clinical depression, and insomnia.
sentences.zh: “我有产后情绪障碍、临床抑郁症和失眠症。”

sentences.en: Yes, I've thought about suicide.
sentences.zh: “是的，我想过自杀。”

sentences.en: What a shocker.
sentences.zh: “这有什么好惊讶的。”

sentences.en: As police dug deeper into Naja's computer activity, they discovered that she'd visited the website alt.suicide.holiday and searched for information on how to kill herself.
sentences.zh: 随着警方深入调查娜嘉的电脑活动，他们发现她曾访问过alt.suicide.holiday网站，并搜索过自杀方法。

sentences.en: During her brief period on the website,
sentences.zh: 在浏览该网站的短暂期间，

sentences.en: Naja had befriended another poster in her 20s named Cammy D.
sentences.zh: 娜嘉结识了另一位20多岁的网友，名叫卡米·D（Cammy D）。

sentences.en: The two had started contacting each other privately.
sentences.zh: 两人开始私下联系。

sentences.en: I wonder how it would feel to actually die, Naja mused in one message.
sentences.zh: “我很好奇真正死去是什么感觉，”娜嘉在一条信息中沉思道。

sentences.en: Nice, Cammy D replied.
sentences.zh: “很棒，”卡米·D回复道。

sentences.en: When Naja asked Cammy to share her story, Cammy explained,
sentences.zh: 当娜嘉请卡米分享她的故事时，卡米解释说：

sentences.en: Well, I've had severe depression for 12 years.
sentences.zh: “嗯，我患有严重的抑郁症已经12年了。”

sentences.en: Meds, therapy, yoga, prayers.
sentences.zh: “药物、治疗、瑜伽、祈祷。”

sentences.en: Nothing has helped me get any better.
sentences.zh: “什么都没能让我好起来。”

sentences.en: So about eight months or so ago, I started looking for methods to let go with.
sentences.zh: “所以大约八个月前，我开始寻找解脱的方法。”

sentences.en: And since I've seen every method possible used, I know what does and doesn't work.
sentences.zh: “既然我见过所有可能的方法，我就知道什么有效，什么无效。”

sentences.en: So that's why I chose hanging.
sentences.zh: “所以我选择了上吊。”

sentences.en: Cammy D told Naja she was a nurse employed in an emergency room.
sentences.zh: 卡米·D告诉娜嘉，她是一名急诊室护士。

sentences.en: During the course of her work, she'd seen the terrible results of suicide attempts that hadn't worked.
sentences.zh: 在工作中，她见过那些自杀未遂后的惨状。

sentences.en: She wrote, quote,
sentences.zh: 她写道，引用如下：

sentences.en: I'm not trying to scare you, don't get me wrong.
sentences.zh: “我不是想吓你，别误会。”

sentences.en: I've seen tons of failed overdoses and bad wrist cuttings and some failed jumpers.
sentences.zh: “我见过无数次服药过量、割腕和跳楼未遂的案例。”

sentences.en: In seven years, I've never seen a failed hanging.
sentences.zh: “七年来，我从未见过上吊失败的。”

sentences.en: That's why I chose it.
sentences.zh: “这就是我选择它的原因。”

sentences.en: She repeatedly told Naja that death by hanging was guaranteed, quick and pain-free.
sentences.zh: 她反复告诉娜嘉，上吊自杀是绝对有效、快速且无痛的。

sentences.en: Naja said she planned to take her life on the coming Sunday.
sentences.zh: 娜嘉说她计划在接下来的周日结束生命。

sentences.en: Cammy asked her, You want to use hanging too?
sentences.zh: 卡米问她：“你也想用上吊吗？”

sentences.en: Naja responded that she planned to jump into the frozen Rito River while wearing her ice skates.
sentences.zh: 娜嘉回答说，她打算穿着冰鞋跳进结冰的里多河。

sentences.en: She'd noticed a break in the river's ice right beneath the bridge.
sentences.zh: 她注意到桥下的冰面有个裂口。

sentences.en: The water below was rough and she suspected it would carry her under the ice, drowning her.
sentences.zh: 下面的水流湍急，她猜想水流会把她卷到冰层下，导致溺亡。

sentences.en: If that didn't work, the below freezing temperatures would give her hypothermia.
sentences.zh: 如果那没用，零度以下的气温也会让她死于体温过低。

sentences.en: Naja wanted her death to look like an accident as she felt that would lessen her family's suffering.
sentences.zh: 娜嘉希望她的死看起来像是一场意外，因为她觉得这样能减轻家人的痛苦。

sentences.en: Cammy wasn't convinced.
sentences.zh: 卡米并不信服。

sentences.en: She told Naja she had seen terrible injuries in people who had tried to die by jumping.
sentences.zh: 她告诉娜嘉，她见过那些试图跳楼自杀的人受到的可怕伤害。

sentences.en: If you wanted to do hanging, we could have done it together online, so it would not have been so scary for you, she said.
sentences.zh: “如果你想上吊，我们可以一起在网上进行，这样你就不会那么害怕了，”她说。

sentences.en: Naja and Cammy spoke again a few days later on Sunday March 9, the last day that Naja had been seen alive.
sentences.zh: 几天后的3月9日星期日，也就是娜嘉最后一次被人看到活着的那天，娜嘉和卡米再次交谈。

sentences.en: Naja told Cammy she planned to go out later that night to carry out her plan.
sentences.zh: 娜嘉告诉卡米，她打算当晚晚些时候出去执行计划。

sentences.en: Cammy didn't try to convince Naja that her life was worth saving.
sentences.zh: 卡米并没有试图说服娜嘉她的生命值得拯救。

sentences.en: Instead, she again tried to convince Naja to hang herself via webcam with her.
sentences.zh: 相反，她再次试图说服娜嘉通过摄像头和她一起上吊。

sentences.en: Naja resisted Cammy's urging and later that night she left her dorm room and disappeared into the cold Ottawa night.
sentences.zh: 娜嘉拒绝了卡米的怂恿，当晚晚些时候，她离开了宿舍，消失在渥太华寒冷的夜色中。

sentences.en: Police printed out the transcripts of Naja's online conversations for her parents to see.
sentences.zh: 警方打印了娜嘉的在线对话记录给她的父母看。

sentences.en: They were shocked.
sentences.zh: 他们震惊了。

sentences.en: They had known Naja wasn't her usual cheerful self when they'd last seen her, but didn't realise how depressed she'd actually been.
sentences.zh: 他们最后一次见到娜嘉时，就知道她不像平时那么开朗，但没想到她竟然抑郁到了这种程度。

sentences.en: Naja had confided in her mother about her unplanned pregnancy and miscarriage.
sentences.zh: 娜嘉曾向母亲吐露过她意外怀孕和流产的事。

sentences.en: However, she had concealed her struggle with insomnia, her ongoing appointments with the psychiatrist, and that she'd started discussing suicide with other people online.
sentences.zh: 然而，她隐瞒了自己与失眠的抗争、持续看精神科医生的事，以及她开始在网上与人讨论自杀的事。

sentences.en: Naja's parents realised that their initial suspicions about Naja falling victim to foul play had been wrong.
sentences.zh: 娜嘉的父母意识到，他们最初怀疑娜嘉遭遇不测的猜测是错误的。

sentences.en: For them, the knowledge that their daughter had seemingly taken her own life was more painful
sentences.zh: 对他们来说，得知女儿似乎是自杀身亡，比相信她被囚禁在某处更痛苦，

sentences.en: than believing she might be held somewhere against her will, as it eliminated all hope.
sentences.zh: 因为它抹杀了一切希望。

sentences.en: Police realised that Naja Kijuji's body most likely lay somewhere in or near the Rideau River,
sentences.zh: 警方意识到，娜嘉·基朱吉的遗体很可能就在里多河中或附近，

sentences.en: but her three-foot blanket of snow had fallen over Ottawa, hampering the search efforts.
sentences.zh: 但渥太华下了三英尺厚的雪，阻碍了搜寻工作。

sentences.en: In the weeks following Naja's disappearance, her parents learnt that while they had been in the dark about their daughter's depression, her university had not.
sentences.zh: 在娜嘉失踪后的几周里，她的父母得知，虽然他们对女儿的抑郁症一无所知，但学校却并非如此。

sentences.en: Several months earlier, Naja had gone to a local restaurant carrying a razor blade.
sentences.zh: 几个月前，娜嘉曾带着一把剃须刀去了一家当地餐馆。

sentences.en: She told people in the restaurant that if somebody didn't help her, she was going to hurt herself.
sentences.zh: 她告诉餐馆里的人，如果没人帮她，她就要伤害自己。

sentences.en: An ambulance was called and Naja was taken to hospital.
sentences.zh: 救护车被叫来，娜嘉被送往医院。

sentences.en: On another occasion, one of Naja's roommates had contacted campus security to alert them of their belief that Naja was suicidal.
sentences.zh: 另有一次，娜嘉的一名室友联系了校园保安，提醒他们娜嘉有自杀倾向。

sentences.en: Naja had told her psychiatrist that she was suicidal and had considered multiple ways that she might take her own life.
sentences.zh: 娜嘉曾告诉她的精神科医生她有自杀倾向，并考虑过多种自杀方式。

sentences.en: Naja's parents were distraught.
sentences.zh: 娜嘉的父母悲痛欲绝。

sentences.en: They didn't understand why they hadn't been informed about these events, or why it had taken the university two days to call them after Naja disappeared.
sentences.zh: 他们不明白为什么这些事没通知他们，也不明白为什么娜嘉失踪后，学校过了两天给他们打电话。

sentences.en: University officials responded that confidentiality laws prevented them from reaching out to a student's parents.
sentences.zh: 校方回应称，保密法禁止他们联系学生的父母。

sentences.en: The university's vice president for student support services released a statement
sentences.zh: 学校负责学生支持服务的副校长发表声明称，

sentences.en: that they had reviewed all the actions the institution had taken in response to Naja's situation and, quote,
sentences.zh: 他们已经审查了学校针对娜嘉的情况所采取的所有行动，并引用如下：

sentences.en: We really feel that we've done everything that we could.
sentences.zh: “我们真心觉得我们已经尽了全力。”

sentences.en: Six weeks after Naja vanished, the snow around Ottawa started to thaw.
sentences.zh: 娜嘉失踪六周后，渥太华周围的积雪开始融化。

sentences.en: On April 19, 2008, a boater on the Rideau River discovered her body snagged on a rock.
sentences.zh: 2008年4月19日，一名在里多河上的船夫发现了她被岩石钩住的遗体。

sentences.en: She was fully dressed and wearing her ice skates.
sentences.zh: 她穿着整齐，脚上还穿着冰鞋。

sentences.en: An autopsy confirmed that Naja had died from either drowning or hypothermia.
sentences.zh: 尸检证实，娜嘉死于溺水或体温过低。

sentences.en: By this point, Ottawa police had already traced the messages sent by Naja's online friend, Kami D.
sentences.zh: 此时，渥太华警方已经追踪到了娜嘉的网友“卡米·D”发送的信息。

sentences.en: By looking into the internet protocol, or IP address, from where the messages had been sent, they determined Kami D lived almost 2,000 kilometres away in Faribault, Minnesota.
sentences.zh: 通过调查发送信息的互联网协议（即IP地址），他们确定卡米·D住在近2000公里外的明尼苏达州法里博（Faribault）。

sentences.en: On March 26, 2008, more than three weeks before Naja Kijuji's body was found,
sentences.zh: 2008年3月26日，在纳贾·基朱吉（Naja Kijuji）的遗体被发现的三周多前，

sentences.en: Ottawa police contacted a law enforcement in Faribault to request a welfare check.
sentences.zh: 渥太华警方联系了法里博（Faribault）的执法部门，请求进行一次福利检查。

sentences.en: They explained that they had information indicating a local resident had made a suicide pact with a young woman in Ottawa who was missing and believed to be dead.
sentences.zh: 他们解释说，有信息表明当地一名居民与渥太华一名失踪且被认为已经死亡的年轻女子达成了自杀协议。

sentences.en: But when Faribault police went to the address in question, they found that everybody there was alive and well.
sentences.zh: 但当法里博警方赶到该地址时，发现那里的人都安然无恙。

sentences.en: The day before investigators in Ottawa contacted police in Faribault, a sergeant in the nearby city of St Paul received information from a private citizen
sentences.zh: 在渥太华调查人员联系法里博警方的前一天，附近圣保罗市的一名警官收到了一位私人公民提供的信息，

sentences.en: who had been conducting her own investigation from her home in Berkshire, England.
sentences.zh: 她一直在英国伯克郡的家中进行自己的调查。

sentences.en: For almost two years, Celia Blay had been hard at work looking into the Ash poster who called herself Lee Dow, and later Falcon Girl.
sentences.zh: 近两年来，西莉亚·布雷（Celia Blay）一直在努力调查那个在Ash论坛上自称“李·道”（Lee Dow），后来又自称“猎鹰女孩”（Falcon Girl）的网友。

sentences.en: Although Celia's first attempt to notify law enforcement had been unsuccessful, she hadn't given up.
sentences.zh: 尽管西莉亚第一次尝试通知执法部门时并未成功，但她并没有放弃。

sentences.en: Celia went out of her way to contact Ash forum members who'd been messaged by Lee Dow.
sentences.zh: 西莉亚不遗余力地联系了那些曾收到“李·道”私信的Ash论坛成员。

sentences.en: Celia informed them that Lee Dow was a serial predator who made false suicide pacts with vulnerable people due to some sick reason of her own.
sentences.zh: 西莉亚告知他们，“李·道”是一个连环掠夺者，出于某种病态的动机，专门与脆弱的人达成虚假的自杀协议。

sentences.en: Celia also left posts in the public forum alerting users to Lee Dow's MO.
sentences.zh: 西莉亚还在公共论坛上发帖，提醒用户注意“李·道”的作案手法。

sentences.en: Other forum members began reaching out to Celia to report their own encounters with Lee Dow, and she kept an ever-growing list of interactions.
sentences.zh: 其他论坛成员开始联系西莉亚，报告他们与“李·道”的接触经历，她也因此保留了一份不断增长的互动名单。

sentences.en: In late 2007, Celia's efforts caught the attention of a 35-year-old woman named Kat Lowe.
sentences.zh: 2007年底，西莉亚的努力引起了一位名叫凯特·洛（Kat Lowe）的35岁女性的注意。

sentences.en: Kat lived in the English city of Wolverhampton and was struggling.
sentences.zh: 凯特住在英国伍尔弗汉普顿市，生活十分艰难。

sentences.en: She was unemployed and clinically depressed.
sentences.zh: 她失业了，并患有临床抑郁症。

sentences.en: Her ex had primary custody of her two children, resulting in Kat only seeing them on school holidays.
sentences.zh: 她的前任拥有两个孩子的监护权，导致凯特只能在学校假期才能见到他们。

sentences.en: To numb her trauma and distress, Kat self-medicated with heroin.
sentences.zh: 为了麻痹自己的创伤和痛苦，凯特用海洛因进行自我治疗。

sentences.en: Lately, she'd found a living so difficult that she was considering ending her life.
sentences.zh: 最近，她觉得生活太难了，以至于考虑结束自己的生命。

sentences.en: Like so many others, Kat turned to Ash to talk to others who could relate to her pain.
sentences.zh: 像许多其他人一样，凯特转向Ash论坛，与那些能理解她痛苦的人交流。

sentences.en: One of the people she met there was Falcon Girl.
sentences.zh: 她在那里遇到的人之一就是“猎鹰女孩”。

sentences.en: It felt like every time Kat logged on, Falcon Girl would send her a private message, keen to chat.
sentences.zh: 感觉每次凯特上线，“猎鹰女孩”都会给她发私信，热切地想要聊天。

sentences.en: She kept trying to convince Kat that if she wanted to end her life, she should hang herself.
sentences.zh: 她不断试图说服凯特，如果她想结束生命，就应该上吊自杀。

sentences.en: When a teenage friend of Kat's from the forum entered into a suicide pact with Falcon Girl and nearly killed herself,
sentences.zh: 当凯特在论坛认识的一位十几岁的朋友与“猎鹰女孩”达成自杀协议并差点自杀身亡时，

sentences.en: Kat realised that Falcon Girl was a dangerous individual with no qualms about preying on children.
sentences.zh: 凯特意识到“猎鹰女孩”是一个危险人物，对伤害孩子毫无顾忌。

sentences.en: She reached out to Celia Blay and offered to help her cause.
sentences.zh: 她联系了西莉亚·布雷，并提出要帮助她。

sentences.en: Kat suggested that she go undercover and befriend Falcon Girl.
sentences.zh: 凯特建议自己进行卧底，与“猎鹰女孩”交朋友。

sentences.en: She would try to coax information from her that might give some indication as to her true identity.
sentences.zh: 她会尝试从对方口中套出信息，以寻找其真实身份的线索。

sentences.en: Although Kat was scared that Falcon Girl might convince her to take her own life during the process, she was determined to help where she could.
sentences.zh: 尽管凯特很害怕在这个过程中“猎鹰女孩”会说服她自杀，但她决心尽己所能提供帮助。

sentences.en: Celia accepted Kat's offer and gifted her a gold crucifix necklace as a symbol of strength.
sentences.zh: 西莉亚接受了凯特的提议，并送给她一条金色的十字架项链作为力量的象征。

sentences.en: Kat promised that so long as she was wearing the necklace, she wouldn't attempt suicide.
sentences.zh: 凯特承诺，只要戴着这条项链，她就不会尝试自杀。

sentences.en: Kat sent Falcon Girl an email saying she wanted to take her own life and needed some advice.
sentences.zh: 凯特给“猎鹰女孩”发了一封邮件，说她想自杀，需要一些建议。

sentences.en: Although she claimed to be 31 instead of in her 20s like Lee Dao, there were many identical features to the Lee Dao messages.
sentences.zh: 虽然她声称自己31岁，而不是像“李·道”那样20多岁，但这些信息与“李·道”的有很多相似之处。

sentences.en: Rather than asking if Kat had sought help via therapy or medication, Falcon Girl wrote back with some tips about dying by hanging.
sentences.zh: “猎鹰女孩”没有问凯特是否寻求过心理治疗或药物帮助，而是回信提供了一些关于上吊自杀的技巧。

sentences.en: She added that having a webcam would help so she could guide Kat remotely when the time came.
sentences.zh: 她还补充说，如果有一个网络摄像头会更好，这样当时间到了的时候，她可以远程指导凯特。

sentences.en: She signed off her message with the word Hugs and her name, Kami D.
sentences.zh: 她在邮件末尾写上了“拥抱”一词，并署名“Kami D”。

sentences.en: A few days later, Kami emailed Kat again to check in.
sentences.zh: 几天后，Kami再次发邮件给凯特询问情况。

sentences.en: Kat replied that she was trying to find a mental health care professional to help her, adding,
sentences.zh: 凯特回复说她正在努力寻找心理健康专家来帮助她，并补充道：

sentences.en: If they don't offer me the help I need, I can't see any other option than to end it.
sentences.zh: “如果他们不能提供我需要的帮助，我看不出还有什么选择，只能结束它。”

sentences.en: Kami D wrote back,
sentences.zh: Kami D回信道：

sentences.en: Then she signed off with the word Hugs.
sentences.zh: 然后她以“拥抱”一词结尾。

sentences.en: The two started chatting more and more frequently.
sentences.zh: 两人开始越来越频繁地聊天。

sentences.en: Kami repeatedly offered to watch Kat's suicide via webcam if she wanted her to.
sentences.zh: Kami多次主动提出，如果凯特愿意，她可以通过摄像头观看凯特的自杀过程。

sentences.en: She also told her about her experience in an emergency room and how it had led her to her belief that hanging was the most dependable suicide method.
sentences.zh: 她还告诉凯特她在急诊室的经历，以及这如何让她相信上吊是最可靠的自杀方式。

sentences.en: Kami D confided in Kat that she had already helped at least four people to hang themselves.
sentences.zh: Kami D向凯特吐露，她已经至少帮助四个人上吊自杀了。

sentences.en: Kat asked if Kami had watched the suicides via webcam and if she was worried about getting in trouble as a result.
sentences.zh: 凯特问Kami是否通过摄像头观看了这些自杀过程，以及她是否担心因此惹上麻烦。

sentences.en: Kami said she'd only watched one and had done so because the individual hadn't wanted to be alone.
sentences.zh: Kami说她只看过一次，因为那个人不想独自一人。

sentences.en: He was a 32-year-old man from Birmingham, England.
sentences.zh: 那是一个来自英国伯明翰的32岁男子。

sentences.en: Kami wasn't concerned about the police chasing her up because she intended to die soon too.
sentences.zh: Kami并不担心警察会追查她，因为她也打算很快死去。

sentences.en: She assured Kat that she was finally ready to take her own life and would commit to any suicide pact they entered together.
sentences.zh: 她向凯特保证，她终于准备好结束自己的生命，并会履行他们共同达成的任何自杀协议。

sentences.en: At Kat's request, Kami sent through a photo of herself with what appeared to be her grey-haired husband and two teenage daughters.
sentences.zh: 应凯特的要求，Kami发来了一张照片，照片里似乎是她灰头发的丈夫和两个十几岁的女儿。

sentences.en: They posed together, smiling happily on a piano bench.
sentences.zh: 他们坐在钢琴凳上，开心地微笑着合影。

sentences.en: The woman in the photo had short dark hair and was dressed conservatively in a cardigan and high-necked black top.
sentences.zh: 照片中的女子留着短黑发，穿着保守的开衫和高领黑色上衣。

sentences.en: Kat presumed that the woman was Kami, but found the photo rather odd.
sentences.zh: 凯特推测那个女人就是Kami，但觉得这张照片很奇怪。

sentences.en: Kami had been telling everyone she was a young woman, but the couple pictured looked to be in their mid-forties at leaSt.
sentences.zh: Kami一直告诉大家她是个年轻女子，但照片里的夫妇看起来至少有四十多岁了。

sentences.en: While Kami typically offered the people she chatted with reasons why she couldn't use her webcam, Kat finally coaxed Kami into switching hers on while they talked.
sentences.zh: 虽然Kami通常会向聊天对象找借口说不能使用摄像头，但凯特最终还是说服了Kami在谈话时打开了摄像头。

sentences.en: Kami wouldn't sit within sight of the camera's lens, but agreed to keep it on nonetheless.
sentences.zh: Kami不愿坐在镜头范围内，但还是同意保持开启。

sentences.en: One day, as Kat and Kami typed back and forth, Kat suddenly noticed something.
sentences.zh: 有一天，当凯特和Kami互相打字聊天时，凯特突然注意到了什么。

sentences.en: A person had come into view of Kami's camera.
sentences.zh: 一个人出现在了Kami的摄像头视野中。

sentences.en: Kat grabbed her cell phone and managed to quickly snap a photo of the individual before they exited from view.
sentences.zh: 凯特抓起手机，在对方离开视野前迅速拍下了一张照片。

sentences.en: The person she'd photographed wasn't the woman from Kami's picture.
sentences.zh: 她拍到的人并不是Kami照片里的那个女人。

sentences.en: It was the man.
sentences.zh: 而是那个男人。

sentences.en: You're a bloke, Kat typed.
sentences.zh: “你是个男人，”凯特打字道。

sentences.en: But the man didn't log off.
sentences.zh: 但那个男人没有下线。

sentences.en: Instead, he asked Kat,
sentences.zh: 相反，他问凯特：

sentences.en: Does it matter?
sentences.zh: “这重要吗？”

sentences.en: Kat replied, no.
sentences.zh: 凯特回答说，不重要。

sentences.en: But she asked why he was pretending to be a young woman.
sentences.zh: 但她问他为什么要假装成一个年轻女子。

sentences.en: Was this motivated by some sexual desire?
sentences.zh: 这是出于某种性欲吗？

sentences.en: The man said no, it was a form of self-protection.
sentences.zh: 男人说不是，这是一种自我保护。

sentences.en: He explained that if there were ever any legal ramifications for his helping suicidal people, then the authorities would be searching for a woman, not a man.
sentences.zh: 他解释说，如果他帮助有自杀倾向的人而产生任何法律后果，当局会寻找一个女人，而不是一个男人。

sentences.en: Kat told Celia Blay about her latest discoveries.
sentences.zh: 凯特将她的最新发现告诉了西莉亚·布雷。

sentences.en: At around the same time, another member of the forum who was experienced in telecommunications
sentences.zh: 大约在同一时间，论坛的另一位精通电信的成员

sentences.en: helped Celia trace Lee Dow and Kami D's emails to a server in the Minnesota city of Faribault.
sentences.zh: 帮助西莉亚将“李·道”和“Kami D”的邮件追踪到了明尼苏达州法里博市的一台服务器上。

sentences.en: Celia finally felt like she was getting closer to making an identification.
sentences.zh: 西莉亚终于觉得她离查明身份更近了一步。

sentences.en: The final piece of the puzzle came when the man sent an email with a mistake in it.
sentences.zh: 当那个男人发来的一封邮件中出现了一个错误时，拼图的最后一块终于拼上了。

sentences.en: He had included his real name in the subject's header.
sentences.zh: 他在邮件主题栏中包含了他的真实姓名。

sentences.en: William Melchert Dinkle.
sentences.zh: 威廉·梅尔切特·丁克尔（William Melchert Dinkle）。

sentences.en: After Melchert Dinkle told Kat Lowe that he'd watched a man in Birmingham suicide on his webcam,
sentences.zh: 在梅尔切特·丁克尔告诉凯特·洛他曾通过摄像头观看一名伯明翰男子自杀后，

sentences.en: Celia drove to the West Midlands to report his claim to the authorities there.
sentences.zh: 西莉亚开车前往西米德兰兹，向当地当局报告了他的说法。

sentences.en: She provided them with a CD filled with all the case evidence she'd managed to gather so far.
sentences.zh: 她向他们提供了一张光盘，里面装满了她迄今为止收集到的所有案件证据。

sentences.en: But Birmingham police treated Celia with the same dismissive attitude as the officers in Berkshire.
sentences.zh: 但伯明翰警方对待西莉亚的态度和伯克郡的警官一样冷漠。

sentences.en: One Birmingham policeman called Celia's husband at their home to check if he knew where his wife was and what she was doing.
sentences.zh: 一名伯明翰警察甚至打电话给西莉亚的丈夫，询问他是否知道妻子在哪里，在做什么。

sentences.en: Celia also tried speaking to an English member of parliament, but got nowhere once again.
sentences.zh: 西莉亚还尝试与一位英国国会议员交谈，但再次碰壁。

sentences.en: In February of 2008, Celia sent an email to the United States Federal Bureau of Investigation, or FBI.
sentences.zh: 2008年2月，西莉亚给美国联邦调查局（FBI）发了一封电子邮件。

sentences.en: She hoped that authorities in the country where William Melchert Dinkle resided might take more of an intereSt.
sentences.zh: 她希望威廉·梅尔切特·丁克尔居住国的当局能对此事更感兴趣。

sentences.en: But, unbeknownst to Celia, the email wasn't received.
sentences.zh: 然而，西莉亚不知道的是，这封邮件并没有收到。

sentences.en: At her wits end, Celia reached out to an online friend named Mary Jo, who also lived in the state of Minnesota.
sentences.zh: 走投无路的西莉亚联系了一位名叫玛丽·乔（Mary Jo）的网友，她也住在明尼苏达州。

sentences.en: The pair had met through Celia's small business and bonded over their interest in horses.
sentences.zh: 两人通过西莉亚的小生意相识，并因对马匹的共同兴趣而结缘。

sentences.en: When Mary Jo heard what Celia had to say about William Melchert Dinkle, she offered to put her in touch with an old friend who worked at the sheriff's department.
sentences.zh: 当玛丽·乔听到西莉亚关于威廉·梅尔切特·丁克尔的描述时，她主动提出帮她联系一位在治安官办公室工作的老朋友。

sentences.en: He, in turn, told Celia to contact Minnesota's Bureau of Criminal Apprehension, which had an entire department dedicated to pursuing adults who targeted children online.
sentences.zh: 那个人反过来告诉西莉亚联系明尼苏达州的刑事侦查局，该局有一个专门负责追查在线针对儿童的成年人的部门。

sentences.en: In late March 2008, Celia sat down to write another pleading email.
sentences.zh: 2008年3月底，西莉亚坐下来写了另一封恳求的邮件。

sentences.en: The email was opened by Sergeant William Hayter of the St. Paul Police Department, who was on assignment with the Internet Crimes Against Children Task Force.
sentences.zh: 这封邮件被圣保罗警察局的威廉·海特（William Hayter）警官打开，他当时正受命于“互联网儿童犯罪特别工作组”。

sentences.en: Celia Blay had outlined that there was an online predator who was deliberately deceiving vulnerable people in order to manipulate them into suiciding.
sentences.zh: 西莉亚·布雷概述说，有一个网络掠夺者正在蓄意欺骗脆弱的人，以操纵他们自杀。

sentences.en: She named the predator as Minnesota resident William Melchert Dinkle and included details about his MO and six different aliases he was known to use.
sentences.zh: 她指名该掠夺者为明尼苏达州居民威廉·梅尔切特·丁克尔，并提供了关于他的作案手法和六个已知别名的详细信息。

sentences.en: Although Sergeant Hayter was taken aback by the bizarre story, he was also intrigued.
sentences.zh: 尽管海特警官对这个离奇的故事感到震惊，但他也很感兴趣。

sentences.en: He took up the case and Celia continued to send him more evidence, including five different email addresses Melchert Dinkle used and chat logs of his conversations.
sentences.zh: 他接手了此案，西莉亚继续向他发送更多证据，包括梅尔切特·丁克尔使用的五个不同的电子邮件地址和聊天记录。

sentences.en: Sergeant Hayter learnt that William Melchert Dinkle was a 46-year-old nurse who was married with two daughters.
sentences.zh: 海特警官了解到，威廉·梅尔切特·丁克尔是一名46岁的护士，已婚，有两个女儿。

sentences.en: He hadn't worked in an emergency department like his alter egos, but was employed in a nursing home.
sentences.zh: 他并没有像他的化身那样在急诊室工作，而是在一家疗养院工作。

sentences.en: In 1994, he gave one resident incorrect medication.
sentences.zh: 1994年，他给一位住户服用了错误的药物。

sentences.en: In another incident, he failed to document a patient's deteriorating condition and they later died while en route to a hospital.
sentences.zh: 在另一起事件中，他未能记录一名病人的病情恶化情况，导致该病人在送往医院途中死亡。

sentences.en: In 1995, Melchert Dinkle started working in the ortho-neuro unit at St. Paul Hospital, where his poor work performance continued.
sentences.zh: 1995年，梅尔切特·丁克尔开始在圣保罗医院的骨科神经科工作，但他糟糕的工作表现依然持续。

sentences.en: His inability to retain information became a problem.
sentences.zh: 他无法记住信息成为了一个问题。

sentences.en: And he blamed his poor concentration on issues at home.
sentences.zh: 他把注意力不集中归咎于家庭问题。

sentences.en: Melchert Dinkle was subsequently diagnosed with a learning disability and attention deficit disorder.
sentences.zh: 梅尔切特·丁克尔随后被诊断出患有学习障碍和注意力缺陷障碍。

sentences.en: He was put on medication but still felt overwhelmed at work, leading him to resign.
sentences.zh: 他开始服药，但仍感到工作压力巨大，最终辞职。

sentences.en: He found a job at another nursing home, where he was found to have abused two residents and was ultimately fired.
sentences.zh: 他在另一家疗养院找到了一份工作，在那里他被发现虐待了两名住户，最终被解雇。

sentences.en: After this, the Minnesota Board of Nursing limited his licence so he could only work under supervision.
sentences.zh: 此后，明尼苏达州护理委员会限制了他的执照，要求他只能在监督下工作。

sentences.en: He continued to find work in nursing homes, but co-workers complained about his poor skills and rude attitude towards patients.
sentences.zh: 他继续在疗养院找工作，但同事们抱怨他技能差，对病人态度粗鲁。

sentences.en: By mid-2008, he was working at his fourth nursing home.
sentences.zh: 到2008年中期，他已经在第四家疗养院工作了。

sentences.en: On Wednesday, January 7, 2009, Sergeant Hayter and two colleagues travelled to William Melchert Dinkle's home in Faribault, Minnesota.
sentences.zh: 2009年1月7日星期三，海特警官和两名同事前往威廉·梅尔切特·丁克尔位于明尼苏达州法里博的家中。

sentences.en: It was a white shingled house with black shutters and a perfectly manicured front lawn.
sentences.zh: 那是一栋带有黑色百叶窗的白色木瓦房，前草坪修剪得非常整齐。

sentences.en: Melchert Dinkle invited the officers into his home.
sentences.zh: 梅尔切特·丁克尔邀请警官进入家中。

sentences.en: They introduced themselves and said they wished to speak to him regarding some internet-related issues.
sentences.zh: 他们做了自我介绍，并表示希望就一些与互联网相关的问题与他谈谈。

sentences.en: I think I know what you mean, replied Melchert Dinkle.
sentences.zh: “我想我知道你们指的是什么，”梅尔切特·丁克尔回答道。

sentences.en: When the officers asked him to explain his remark, he said he had, quote,
sentences.zh: 当警官要求他解释这句话时，他说他有，引用：

sentences.en: Some concerns about some of the internet activity that has been going on here regarding issues with suicide and so forth.
sentences.zh: “一些关于这里发生的互联网活动的担忧，涉及自杀等问题。”

sentences.en: Melchert Dinkle explained that he and his wife both worked in healthcare and that in that capacity, they had conversations with people online about depression and suicide.
sentences.zh: 梅尔切特·丁克尔解释说，他和妻子都在医疗保健行业工作，以这种身份，他们会在网上与人讨论抑郁和自杀问题。

sentences.en: Some of the conversations had gotten inappropriate.
sentences.zh: 其中一些对话变得不恰当了。

sentences.en: The officers asked if his wife should be included in the interview.
sentences.zh: 警官询问是否应该让他的妻子也参加这次谈话。

sentences.en: Melchert Dinkle then changed tack, admitting that his wife had nothing to do with the online discussions.
sentences.zh: 梅尔切特·丁克尔随即改变了说法，承认他的妻子与这些在线讨论无关。

sentences.en: He, on the other hand, had been acting as a, quote,
sentences.zh: 而他自己，一直扮演着一个，引用：

sentences.en: A divisor in suicide methods, dispensing detailed advice about dying by hanging in particular.
sentences.zh: “自杀方法的传播者，提供关于如何死亡的详细建议，特别是上吊。”

sentences.en: He admitted to going into particular forums and using various female aliases.
sentences.zh: 他承认进入特定的论坛并使用各种女性化名。

sentences.en: According to Melchert Dinkle, he'd stopped doing this the previous month due to moral, ethical and legal reasons.
sentences.zh: 据梅尔切特·丁克尔说，由于道德、伦理和法律原因，他上个月已经停止了这样做。

sentences.en: The officers asked Melchert Dinkle if he could name anyone he'd had these conversations with.
sentences.zh: 警官问梅尔切特·丁克尔是否能说出任何他曾与之交谈过的人的名字。

sentences.en: He said he'd spoken to some people in England.
sentences.zh: 他说他曾与英国的一些人交谈过。

sentences.en: He couldn't be certain that they'd died, but he believed so as he'd stopped hearing from them.
sentences.zh: 他不能确定他们是否已经死亡，但他认为是的，因为他不再收到他们的消息了。

sentences.en: He also admitted that he'd had a suicide pact with a young woman from Ottawa who had jumped into a frozen river.
sentences.zh: 他还承认，他曾与一名跳入冰河的渥太华年轻女子达成过自杀协议。

sentences.en: Her name was Nadja Kijuji.
sentences.zh: 她的名字叫纳贾·基朱吉。

sentences.en: Melchert Dinkle had learned of Nadja's suicide after the police in Ottawa traced his emails and had requested a welfare check at his home shortly after Nadja disappeared.
sentences.zh: 梅尔切特·丁克尔是在渥太华警方追踪到他的邮件并在纳贾失踪后不久请求对他家进行福利检查后，才得知纳贾自杀的消息的。

sentences.en: His family had all been away on vacation at the time, but Melchert Dinkle had subsequently confirmed with the police that they were all alive and well.
sentences.zh: 当时他的家人都在外度假，但梅尔切特·丁克尔随后向警方确认他们都安然无恙。

sentences.en: A few weeks after Nadja's body was found, investigators in Ottawa had called Melchert Dinkle at home to follow up on the emails they'd traced.
sentences.zh: 在纳贾的遗体被发现几周后，渥太华的调查人员曾致电梅尔切特·丁克尔家中，跟进他们追踪到的邮件。

sentences.en: Melchert Dinkle told them the home computer was used by his two teenage daughters and that they used the screen name Falcon Girl.
sentences.zh: 梅尔切特·丁克尔告诉他们，家里的电脑是他两个十几岁的女儿使用的，她们使用的网名是“猎鹰女孩”。

sentences.en: The Falcons were the mascot of the local high school in Faribault.
sentences.zh: “猎鹰”是法里博当地高中的吉祥物。

sentences.en: Melchert Dinkle told Ottawa investigators that his daughters must have been the ones conversing with Nadja Kijuji.
sentences.zh: 梅尔切特·丁克尔告诉渥太华调查人员，一定是他的女儿们在与纳贾·基朱吉交谈。

sentences.en: They would have information about suicide due to their mother being a surgical nurse.
sentences.zh: 由于她们的母亲是外科护士，她们会了解自杀的相关信息。

sentences.en: He was very concerned about their behaviour and said he would make sure the issue was addressed.
sentences.zh: 他非常担心她们的行为，并表示会确保这个问题得到解决。

sentences.en: Sergeant Hayder and his colleagues asked Melchert Dinkle to estimate how many people might have suicided as a result of his conversations with them.
sentences.zh: 海特警官和他的同事要求梅尔切特·丁克尔估计有多少人可能因为与他的谈话而自杀。

sentences.en: He said he'd talked about suicide with about 20 people and made suicide packs with about 10.
sentences.zh: 他说他曾与大约20人谈论过自杀，并与大约10人达成了自杀协议。

sentences.en: Melchert Dinkle later increased that figure to dozens.
sentences.zh: 梅尔切特·丁克尔后来将这个数字增加到了几十人。

sentences.en: He guessed that of the people he made packs with, about 5 had probably died.
sentences.zh: 他猜测在他达成协议的人中，大约有5人可能已经死亡。

sentences.en: Melchert Dinkle admitted that he knew it was illegal to assist in suicide.
sentences.zh: 梅尔切特·丁克尔承认他知道协助自杀是违法的。

sentences.en: He'd seen comments posted in suicide forums that warned others to stay away from him, but he hadn't been scared off.
sentences.zh: 他曾看到自杀论坛上有人发帖警告其他人远离他，但他并没有被吓跑。

sentences.en: He kept encouraging others to take their lives, telling them that it was okay to let go and they would be better off in heaven.
sentences.zh: 他继续鼓励其他人结束生命，告诉他们放手没关系，他们在天堂会过得更好。

sentences.en: As he put it, his caring nature went too far.
sentences.zh: 正如他所说，他那富有同情心的天性做得太过火了。

sentences.en: William Melchert Dinkle gave the officers permission to search his home and signed a waiver that would allow them to search his computer as well.
sentences.zh: 威廉·梅尔切特·丁克尔允许警官搜查他的家，并签署了一份弃权书，允许他们搜查他的电脑。

sentences.en: After the interview concluded, Melchert Dinkle went to a local hospital and entered the emergency department.
sentences.zh: 采访结束后，梅尔切特·丁克尔去了当地一家医院，进入了急诊科。

sentences.en: He explained to the nurses there that he was under investigation for assisting suicide.
sentences.zh: 他向那里的护士解释说，他因协助自杀正在接受调查。

sentences.en: He admitted to having an addiction to internet suicide sites and was feeling guilty that he told others how to kill themselves.
sentences.zh: 他承认自己对互联网自杀网站上瘾，并对自己告诉别人如何自杀感到内疚。

sentences.en: He explained that the appeal lay in, quote,
sentences.zh: 他解释说，这种吸引力在于，引用：

sentences.en: Meanwhile, investigators got to work examining the contents of Melchert Dinkle's computer.
sentences.zh: 与此同时，调查人员开始着手检查梅尔彻特·丁克尔电脑里的内容。

sentences.en: They found a photograph of Naja Kijuji and copious messages about suicide from Melchert Dinkle to people he'd met online.
sentences.zh: 他们发现了一张娜佳·基朱吉的照片，以及梅尔彻特·丁克尔发给他在网上结识的人的大量关于自杀的信息。

sentences.en: All of his correspondence consisted of pro-suicide encouragement and highly detailed information about how to hang oneself.
sentences.zh: 他所有的通信内容都是在鼓励自杀，并提供了关于如何上吊的极其详细的信息。

sentences.en: Melchert Dinkle always assured people that hanging was a quick, surefire and painless way to die.
sentences.zh: 梅尔彻特·丁克尔总是向人们保证，上吊是一种快速、万无一失且无痛的死亡方式。

sentences.en: But this is not true.
sentences.zh: 但事实并非如此。

sentences.en: Most likely, he had wanted them to use this particular method because it was the way he hoped to watch them die via a webcam.
sentences.zh: 他很可能希望他们使用这种特定的方法，因为这是他希望通过网络摄像头观看他们死亡的方式。

sentences.en: Police found no evidence that Melchert Dinkle had videos of suicide saved on his computer.
sentences.zh: 警方没有发现任何证据表明梅尔彻特·丁克尔的电脑里存有自杀视频。

sentences.en: Melchert Dinkle had told Cat Lowe that he'd seen one individual hang himself through his webcam, a 32-year-old Englishman from Birmingham.
sentences.zh: 梅尔彻特·丁克尔曾告诉凯特·洛，他通过网络摄像头亲眼目睹了一个人上吊自杀，那是一名来自伯明翰的32岁英国男子。

sentences.en: When police asked about this, he steadfastly denied it.
sentences.zh: 当警方询问此事时，他坚决予以否认。

sentences.en: But he ultimately admitted that there was another 32-year-old man from England who had died as a result of his actions.
sentences.zh: 但他最终承认，确实有另一名32岁的英国男子因他的行为而死亡。

sentences.zh: Casefile节目稍后回来。
