sentences.en: At around 4pm on Wednesday, July 27, 2005, Carol Drybrough drove to her brother Mark's home in Coventry, England.
sentences.zh: 2005年7月27日星期三下午4点左右，卡罗尔·德赖布勒开车前往她哥哥马克在英国考文垂的家中。

sentences.en: The siblings had planned to meet at a nearby park that afternoon.
sentences.zh: 兄妹俩原计划那天下午在附近的公园见面。

sentences.en: When Mark failed to show up, Carol decided to check on him.
sentences.zh: 当马克没有出现时，卡罗尔决定去看看他。

sentences.en: She knocked on Mark's front door, then waited for an answer.
sentences.zh: 她敲了敲马克的家门，然后等待回应。

sentences.en: None came, so Carol let herself in.
sentences.zh: 里面没有动静，于是卡罗尔自己推门进去了。

sentences.en: Taped to the inside door was a note written in block letters that read,
sentences.zh: 门内侧贴着一张用印刷体写成的纸条，上面写着：

sentences.en: Please call the police.
sentences.zh: 请报警。

sentences.en: Do not go upstairs.
sentences.zh: 不要上楼。

sentences.en: Go home.
sentences.zh: 回家去。

sentences.en: Hand this note to the police.
sentences.zh: 把这张纸条交给警察。

sentences.en: Ignoring the message, Carol raced upstairs.
sentences.zh: 卡罗尔无视了纸条上的信息，冲上了楼。

sentences.en: She tried to open Mark's bedroom door, but it was blocked.
sentences.zh: 她试图打开马克的卧室门，但门被堵住了。

sentences.en: After pushing forcefully, Carol was able to get in.
sentences.zh: 在用力推开后，卡罗尔得以进入房间。

sentences.en: Inside, she found Mark's body hanging.
sentences.zh: 在里面，她发现了马克的遗体悬挂着。

sentences.en: Carol tried to prop him up in an effort to save him while simultaneously calling for an ambulance.
sentences.zh: 卡罗尔试图托住他以挽救他的生命，同时呼叫救护车。

sentences.en: She held his weight up the entire time that she waited for paramedics to arrive.
sentences.zh: 在等待医护人员到达的整个过程中，她一直托着他的体重。

sentences.en: Tragically, it was too late and Mark Drybrough had already passed.
sentences.zh: 不幸的是，一切都太晚了，马克·德赖布勒已经去世了。

sentences.en: As a child and teenager, Mark had been mischievous, with a great sense of humour.
sentences.zh: 在童年和少年时期，马克很淘气，非常有幽默感。

sentences.en: At university, he flourished while studying computer engineering and found happiness with a girlfriend.
sentences.zh: 在大学里，他学习计算机工程，成绩优异，并与一位女朋友找到了幸福。

sentences.en: But then Mark contracted glandular fever, which left him with chronic fatigue.
sentences.zh: 但后来马克患上了腺热，导致他患上了慢性疲劳综合征。

sentences.en: From there, his life started to fall apart.
sentences.zh: 从那时起，他的生活开始分崩离析。

sentences.en: His relationship ended and he lost motivation to attend classes, eventually dropping out.
sentences.zh: 他的恋情结束了，他也失去了上课的动力，最终退学了。

sentences.en: Over the next ten years, Mark battled depression and extreme exhaustion.
sentences.zh: 在接下来的十年里，马克一直在与抑郁症和极度疲惫作斗争。

sentences.en: Although he was prescribed medication, he sometimes stopped taking it and suffered from psychotic fits.
sentences.zh: 虽然他开了药，但他有时会停药，并遭受精神病发作的折磨。

sentences.en: His mother Elaine provided financial support, but Mark had little independence, no social life, and low self-esteem.
sentences.zh: 他的母亲伊莱恩提供了经济支持，但马克几乎没有独立能力，没有社交生活，自尊心也很低。

sentences.en: While his death was presumed to be suicide, police still attended the scene and took photographs for an official inqueSt.
sentences.zh: 虽然他的死亡被推定为自杀，但警方仍然赶到现场并拍摄了照片，以进行正式的死因调查。

sentences.en: Although Mark's family were aware of his depression, they didn't know that he was suicidal.
sentences.zh: 尽管马克的家人知道他患有抑郁症，但他们并不知道他有自杀倾向。

sentences.en: They were desperate to understand why he had done what he did.
sentences.zh: 他们迫切想知道他为什么会做出这样的事。

sentences.en: In the weeks leading up to his death, his mother Elaine had noticed that Mark had been spending more and more time on his computer.
sentences.zh: 在他去世前的几周里，他的母亲伊莱恩注意到马克在电脑上花费的时间越来越多。

sentences.en: She and Mark's sister, Carol, began wondering if the answers to their grief might be found in Mark's online activity.
sentences.zh: 她和马克的妹妹卡罗尔开始怀疑，她们悲痛的答案是否能在马克的网络活动中找到。

sentences.en: Carol logged on to his computer and began trawling through his internet history.
sentences.zh: 卡罗尔登录了他的电脑，开始翻阅他的互联网历史记录。

sentences.en: She discovered that earlier that month, on July 1, Mark had posted in a forum dedicated to discussions about suicide.
sentences.zh: 她发现那个月早些时候，即7月1日，马克在一个专门讨论自杀的论坛上发了帖。

sentences.en: Using the handle Spooky, he asked,
sentences.zh: 他使用网名“Spooky”，问道：

sentences.en: Does anyone have details of hanging methods where there isn't access to anything high up to tie the rope to?
sentences.zh: 有人知道在没有高处可以系绳子的情况下，有什么上吊的方法吗？

sentences.en: I've read that people have taken their own lives in jail.
sentences.zh: 我读到过有人在监狱里自杀。

sentences.en: Anybody know of inventive methods, the ones you don't get to read in the paper?
sentences.zh: 有人知道什么创新的方法吗？就是那种你在报纸上读不到的方法？

sentences.en: A user going by the name Lee Dao had replied to Mark with the directive,
sentences.zh: 一个名叫“Lee Dao”的用户回复了马克，并指示道：

sentences.en: Check your email.
sentences.zh: 查收你的电子邮件。

sentences.en: That same day, Lee Dao sent through a long email with the detailed and explicit instructions that answered Mark's question.
sentences.zh: 同一天，Lee Dao发来了一封长邮件，其中包含了回答马克问题的详细且明确的说明。

sentences.en: It closed with the words, If you have any questions, please email me.
sentences.zh: 邮件结尾写道：如果你有任何问题，请给我发邮件。

sentences.en: I'll get back to you ASAP.
sentences.zh: 我会尽快回复你。

sentences.en: Good luck.
sentences.zh: 祝你好运。

sentences.en: Almost three weeks later, Lee Dao sent Mark several more emails.
sentences.zh: 近三周后，Lee Dao又给马克发了几封邮件。

sentences.en: They included words of encouragement, more information on hanging, and the repeated refrain that, as a nurse, Lee Dao had seen many suicide attempts that didn't work,
sentences.zh: 其中包括鼓励的话语、更多关于上吊的信息，以及反复重申作为一名护士，Lee Dao见过许多不成功的自杀尝试，

sentences.en: and therefore recommended hanging every time.
sentences.zh: 因此每次都推荐上吊。

sentences.en: In one email, Lee Dao detailed how, two weeks earlier, another man in England had asked her to witness his suicide via webcam so he wouldn't be alone when he died.
sentences.zh: 在一封邮件中，Lee Dao详细描述了就在两周前，另一名英国男子如何请求她通过网络摄像头见证他的自杀，这样他在死时就不会孤单。

sentences.en: Quote,
sentences.zh: 引用如下：

sentences.en: In the end, I watched him go, and it was very peaceful, and I was pretty pleased I could make this guy's last moment special for him.
sentences.zh: 最后，我看着他离去，过程非常平静，我很高兴能让这个人的最后一刻对他来说变得特别。

sentences.en: We are not alone, and I don't want you to think that either.
sentences.zh: 我们并不孤单，我也不希望你那样想。

sentences.en: Mark had replied to Lee, sharing his personal story and explaining how his chronic fatigue was getting worse with time.
sentences.zh: 马克回复了Lee，分享了他的个人故事，并解释了他的慢性疲劳是如何随着时间的推移而恶化的。

sentences.en: He described how he had practiced taking his own life, but hadn't been ready to do so yet.
sentences.zh: 他描述了自己是如何练习自杀的，但还没有准备好真正去做。

sentences.en: On July 23, Mark sent Lee an email that read in part,
sentences.zh: 7月23日，马克给Lee发了一封邮件，部分内容写道：

sentences.en: Four days later, Mark took his own life using the precise and specific method Lee Dao had sent him.
sentences.zh: 四天后，马克使用了Lee Dao发给他的那种精确而具体的方法结束了自己的生命。

sentences.en: A short time after he died, a final email landed in his inbox from Lee Dao.
sentences.zh: 在他去世后不久，他的收件箱里收到了一封来自Lee Dao的最后邮件。

sentences.en: All it said was,
sentences.zh: 上面只写着：

sentences.en: Are you alright, Mark?
sentences.zh: 你还好吗，马克？

sentences.en: Mark's mother, Elaine, was devastated by Carol's discoveries.
sentences.zh: 马克的母亲伊莱恩对卡罗尔的发现感到悲痛欲绝。

sentences.en: To her, it was as though Lee Dao had decided to become a self-appointed executioner for Elaine's beloved son.
sentences.zh: 对她来说，就好像Lee Dao决定成为她爱子自封的刽子手。

sentences.en: Every time Mark went online, Lee Dao seemed to be whispering in his ear and appealing to his lowest thoughts.
sentences.zh: 每次马克上网，Lee Dao似乎都在他耳边低语，诱导他内心最消极的想法。

sentences.en: Mark's family handed over this evidence to local law enforcement.
sentences.zh: 马克的家人将这些证据交给了当地执法部门。

sentences.en: While the contact from Lee Dao was included in a coronial inquest into Mark's death, the inquest ultimately found that the cause of death was suicide,
sentences.zh: 虽然Lee Dao的联系记录被纳入了对马克死因的调查中，但调查最终认定死因是自杀，

sentences.en: and didn't recommend criminal charges against anyone.
sentences.zh: 并且没有建议对任何人提起刑事指控。

sentences.en: A few weeks after Mark's death, Elaine Drybrough attempted to alert officials to her son's story, contacting authorities both at home in the UK and in the United States.
sentences.zh: 马克去世几周后，伊莱恩·德赖布勒试图提醒官员关注她儿子的故事，并联系了英国和美国的当局。

sentences.en: She penned a letter in which she shared what she knew about the person who'd contacted Mark, that they went by the name Lee, had detailed medical knowledge about suicide,
sentences.zh: 她写了一封信，分享了她所知道的关于那个联系过马克的人的信息：他们自称Lee，拥有关于自杀的详细医学知识，

sentences.en: and supposedly lived in Minnesota.
sentences.zh: 并且据称住在明尼苏达州。

sentences.en: She was concerned that the individual might be getting some sort of pleasure from assisting and attending the death of other people.
sentences.zh: 她担心此人可能从协助和参与他人的死亡中获得某种快感。

sentences.en: But Elaine's multiple attempts to raise the alarm went unanswered.
sentences.zh: 但伊莱恩多次试图拉响警报，却无人回应。

sentences.en: When William Melchett Dinkle was interviewed by Minnesota investigators three and a half years later, he couldn't remember Mark Drybrough's name.
sentences.zh: 三年半后，当威廉·梅尔彻特·丁克尔接受明尼苏达州调查人员采访时，他已经记不起马克·德赖布勒的名字了。

sentences.en: But, after police provided him with Mark's email address, he recalled that it was connected to a 32-year-old Englishman who took his own life by hanging.
sentences.zh: 但是，在警方提供马克的电子邮件地址后，他回忆起这与一名通过上吊自杀的32岁英国男子有关。

sentences.en: Not long after Mark's death,
sentences.zh: 在马克去世后不久，

sentences.en: Melchett Dinkle had come across an English newspaper article about the suicide that noted Mark had received assistance from someone in the United States
sentences.zh: 梅尔彻特·丁克尔偶然看到了一篇关于这起自杀事件的英国报纸文章，文章指出马克曾得到美国某人的协助，

sentences.en: who used the handle Lee Dao.
sentences.zh: 那个人使用的网名是Lee Dao。

sentences.en: This article had confirmed to Melchett Dinkle that he had been involved in another person's death.
sentences.zh: 这篇文章向梅尔彻特·丁克尔证实，他确实参与了另一个人的死亡。

sentences.en: In Minnesota, counselling and encouraging people to take their own lives was against the law.
sentences.zh: 在明尼苏达州，劝导和鼓励他人自杀是违法的。

sentences.en: But no one in the United States had ever been criminally charged with assisting suicide via the internet.
sentences.zh: 但美国从未有人因通过互联网协助自杀而被刑事起诉。

sentences.en: This wasn't a case of somebody physically assisting suicides, but doing so through words on a screen.
sentences.zh: 这不是有人在身体上协助自杀的案件，而是通过屏幕上的文字进行的。

sentences.en: If investigators were intent on pursuing charges against Melchett Dinkle, it was going to be a hard case to prosecute.
sentences.zh: 如果调查人员执意要对梅尔彻特·丁克尔提起诉讼，这将是一起很难起诉的案件。

sentences.en: More than a year after members of the Minnesota Task Force interviewed William Melchett Dinkle,
sentences.zh: 在明尼苏达州特别工作组成员采访威廉·梅尔彻特·丁克尔一年多后，

sentences.en: he was formally charged with two counts of advising, encouraging, or assisting suicide.
sentences.zh: 他被正式指控犯有两项建议、鼓励或协助自杀罪。

sentences.en: One charge was for Mark Drybrough and the other for Nadja Kijuji.
sentences.zh: 一项指控涉及马克·德赖布勒，另一项涉及娜佳·基朱吉。

sentences.en: The case went before a judge-only trial in March 2011.
sentences.zh: 该案于2011年3月进行了仅由法官审理的审判。

sentences.en: Melchett Dinkle's defence attorney said that while his client's behaviour was sick and abhorrent, it wasn't a crime.
sentences.zh: 梅尔彻特·丁克尔的辩护律师表示，虽然他当事人的行为令人作呕且令人厌恶，但这并非犯罪。

sentences.en: He argued that Melchett Dinkle's words alone could not be enough to incite Mark and Nadja to suicide,
sentences.zh: 他辩称，仅凭梅尔彻特·丁克尔的言语不足以煽动马克和娜佳自杀，

sentences.en: and that both had their own mental health crises that were at the root of their deaths.
sentences.zh: 而且他们两人都有各自的精神健康危机，这才是他们死亡的根源。

sentences.en: The prosecution countered by pointing out that Melchett Dinkle had been intent on seeing his victims die,
sentences.zh: 检方反驳说，梅尔彻特·丁克尔一心想看到他的受害者死亡，

sentences.en: and that laws are in place to protect vulnerable people from such predatory behaviour.
sentences.zh: 而且法律的存在是为了保护弱势群体免受这种掠夺性行为的侵害。

sentences.en: Ultimately, the now 52-year-old Melchett Dinkle was convicted of both counts.
sentences.zh: 最终，现年52岁的梅尔彻特·丁克尔两项罪名均成立。

sentences.en: Nadja Kijuji's mother, Debra Shevalia, said the conviction was, quote,
sentences.zh: 娜佳·基朱吉的母亲黛布拉·谢瓦利亚说，这一判决是，引用如下：

sentences.en: A great relief.
sentences.zh: 一种巨大的解脱。

sentences.en: This verdict today substantiates my belief that the internet cannot be allowed to become a safe haven for criminals.
sentences.zh: 今天的判决证实了我的信念，即不能允许互联网成为罪犯的安全避风港。

sentences.en: Mark Drybrough's mother, Elaine, agreed, saying that if Melchett Dinkle had been found not guilty, it would have sent the message that inciting people to suicide was fine.
sentences.zh: 马克·德赖布勒的母亲伊莱恩表示赞同，她说如果梅尔彻特·丁克尔被判无罪，那将传达出煽动他人自杀是可以接受的信息。

sentences.en: William Melchett Dinkle subsequently appealed his conviction and had it reversed, with Minnesota's Supreme Court ruling that merely advising or encouraging suicide
sentences.zh: 威廉·梅尔彻特·丁克尔随后对他的定罪提出上诉并被推翻，明尼苏达州最高法院裁定，仅仅建议或鼓励自杀

sentences.en: was protected under the United States First Amendment, which protects freedom of speech.
sentences.zh: 受到美国宪法第一修正案的保护，该修正案保护言论自由。

sentences.en: In 2014, Melchett Dinkle faced a retrial on the charge of assisting suicides alone.
sentences.zh: 2014年，梅尔彻特·丁克尔因单独协助自杀的指控再次受审。

sentences.en: He was found guilty of assisting Mark Drybrough, who had followed his suicide instructions to the letter.
sentences.zh: 他被判协助马克·德赖布勒罪名成立，马克完全按照他的自杀指示行事。

sentences.en: As Nadja Kijuji hadn't taken her life the way Melchett Dinkle instructed, in her case, he was found guilty of attempting to assiSt.
sentences.zh: 由于娜佳·基朱吉没有按照梅尔彻特·丁克尔指示的方法自杀，在她的案件中，他被判试图协助罪名成立。

sentences.en: William Melchett Dinkle was sentenced to three years in prison, which would be suspended if he served just under six months
sentences.zh: 威廉·梅尔彻特·丁克尔被判处三年监禁，如果他服刑不到六个月，

sentences.en: and abided by the terms of his probation for the following ten years.
sentences.zh: 并遵守随后十年的缓刑条款，刑期将被暂缓执行。

sentences.en: In February of 2015, Melchett Dinkle was released after serving his 178-day sentence.
sentences.zh: 2015年2月，梅尔彻特·丁克尔在服完178天刑期后获释。

sentences.en: A number of myths persist about suicide.
sentences.zh: 关于自杀，存在许多误区。

sentences.en: These include the belief that suicide can't be prevented, that people who talk about it are simply seeking attention, and that suicides are rarely impulsive.
sentences.zh: 其中包括认为自杀无法预防、谈论自杀的人只是在寻求关注，以及自杀很少是冲动行为。

sentences.en: The truth is that many suicides occur as a result of impulsive decisions.
sentences.zh: 事实是，许多自杀是冲动决定的结果。

sentences.en: People who die from suicide often tell at least one other person beforehand that they no longer wish to live, and suicide can be prevented by multiple interventions.
sentences.zh: 死于自杀的人通常会提前告诉至少一个人他们不想再活下去了，而通过多种干预措施是可以预防自杀的。

sentences.en: In Mark Drybrough's case, he was expressing a reluctance to take his own life in the days right before he died.
sentences.zh: 在马克·德赖布勒的案例中，他在去世前的几天里表达了不想自杀的念头。

sentences.en: Nadja Kijuji recorded videos of herself talking about how she might regain her desire to live if she could sleep and find some happiness.
sentences.zh: 娜佳·基朱吉录制了视频，谈论如果她能睡个好觉并找到一些快乐，她可能会重新获得生活的渴望。

sentences.en: Both she and Mark were experiencing depression in part due to external circumstances and traumatic personal events.
sentences.zh: 她和马克都经历着抑郁，部分原因是外部环境和创伤性的个人事件。

sentences.en: There are many factors that can place an individual at risk of suicide, including personal loss and trauma, and societal risk factors like unsafe media representations of suicide
sentences.zh: 有许多因素会使个人处于自杀风险中，包括个人损失和创伤，以及社会风险因素，如不安全的媒体自杀报道

sentences.en: and stigma associated with mental illness.
sentences.zh: 以及与精神疾病相关的污名化。

sentences.en: Community factors such as discrimination also play a role, leading to an increased number of suicides and attempts amongst members of the LGBTQI community
sentences.zh: 歧视等社区因素也起着作用，导致LGBTQI群体成员中自杀和自杀未遂的人数增加，

sentences.en: and others who suffer discrimination.
sentences.zh: 以及其他遭受歧视的人。

sentences.en: Experts say it is best to seek help through official channels that hire mental health professionals, rather than online forums where just anyone can poSt.
sentences.zh: 专家建议最好通过聘请心理健康专业人员的官方渠道寻求帮助，而不是在任何人都可以发帖的在线论坛上寻求帮助。

sentences.en: Organisations such as Lifeline offer support for individuals experiencing suicidal thoughts and emotional distress.
sentences.zh: 像Lifeline这样的组织为有自杀念头和情绪困扰的个人提供支持。

sentences.en: They also provide resources, tools and techniques on a wide range of topics relating to mental health struggles and various life stresses.
sentences.zh: 他们还提供关于心理健康斗争和各种生活压力等广泛主题的资源、工具和技巧。

sentences.en: People who are worried about someone who has expressed suicidal ideation can also find advice and guidance through these organisations.
sentences.zh: 担心表达过自杀意念的人也可以通过这些组织找到建议和指导。

sentences.en: Law enforcement officials and attorneys who prosecuted
sentences.zh: 起诉威廉·梅尔彻特·丁克尔的执法官员和律师

sentences.en: William Melcher Dinkle have said that he sought to exploit the pain of individuals at their lowest point, rather than offer any help or words of support.
sentences.zh: 表示，他试图利用处于人生最低谷的人的痛苦，而不是提供任何帮助或支持的话语。

sentences.en: Because there are often no investigations into suicides, it is impossible to know how many people took their own lives due to Melcher Dinkle's actions.
sentences.zh: 由于通常不会对自杀事件进行调查，因此不可能知道有多少人因梅尔彻特·丁克尔的行为而自杀。

sentences.en: He told police he believed there were five.
